Mba. Ọ dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ na obi gị. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-adụ gị ọdụ mgbe o nyochachara nyocha gị.
Nsonaazụ ya ọ dị ka nke ịwa ahụ nkịtị?
Maka ndị ọrịa ọ dabara, ee, yana obere ọnya na mgbake na-adịkarị ngwa ngwa.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.name: Ịgbanwe valvụ obi
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.summa: Ịwa ahụ ma ọ bụ usoro catheter nke na-eji valvụ igwe ma ọ bụ valvụ anụ ahụ dochie valvụ obi dị warara nke ukwuu ma ọ bụ na-agbapụta.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.what: A na-edozi valvụ na-adịghị mma ebe o kwere omume, ma ọ bụ dochie ya na valvụ igwe (nke na-adịgide ogologo oge mana chọrọ ọgwụ na-eme ka ọbara ghara ikpụkọ ọnụ ruo ndụ niile) ma ọ bụ valvụ anụ ahụ. Ụfọdụ ndị ọrịa nwere ike ịnata valvụ ọhụrụ site n'ọkpọkọ n'ụkwụ (TAVI) kama ịwa ahụ emeghere emeghe.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.who: Ndị nwere valvụ obi dị warara ma ọ bụ na-agbapụta nke na-akpata iku ume ngwa ngwa, mgbu obi akpa, ike ọgwụgwụ ma ọ bụ ịda mbà, ọtụtụ mgbe mgbe ahụ ọkụ rheumatic gasịrị ma ọ bụ n'ihi agadi.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 7 maka otu valvụ: 3 na ngalaba nlekọta pụrụ iche (ICU) na 4 n'ọnụ ụlọ ndị ọrịa na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.recov: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 6 ruo 8 maka ịwa ahụ emeghere emeghe, ọ na-adị obere karịa site n'obere ọnya ma ọ bụ catheter. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka izu 2 ruo 3.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.faq.0: Valvụ igwe ka ọ bụ valvụ anụ ahụ?

Valvụ igwe na-adịgide ogologo oge mana chọrọ ọgwụ na-eme ka ọbara ghara ikpụkọ ọnụ kwa ụbọchị. Valvụ anụ ahụ anaghị achọ nke a mana o nwere ike ịgbasa mgbe afọ 10 ruo 20 gasịrị. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-enyere gị aka ịhọrọ.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.faq.1: Enwere ike idozi valvụ m kama ịgbanwe ya?
Ọtụtụ mgbe, karịsịa valvụ mitral na-agbapụta. A na-ahọrọ ndozi ebe o kwere omume.
treatments.angioplasty.name: Angioplasty akwara obi na itinye stent
treatments.angioplasty.summary: A na-etinye ọkpọkọ dị gịrịgịrị ruo n'akwara obi dị warara, obere balloon na-agbasa ya, a na-ahapụkarị ọkpọkọ nwere ụgbụ a na-akpọ stent ka o mee ka ọ nọgide na-emeghe.
treatments.angioplasty.what: Site n'obere oghere n'nkwojiaka ma ọ bụ n'ọgbụgbọ, a na-eduzi ọkpọkọ dị gịrịgịrị ruo n'obi. Angiogram na-egosi ebe mgbochi ahụ dị, balloon na-emeghe ya, a na-ahapụkwa stent e tere ọgwụ n'ebe ahụ ka o mee ka ọ nọgide na-emeghe.
treatments.angioplasty.who: Ndị nwere mgbu obi akpa ma ọ bụ nkụchi obi (heart attack) nke otu ma ọ bụ akwara obi ole na ole dị warara kpatara.
treatments.angioplasty.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 2: 1 na ngalaba nlekọta pụrụ iche (ICU) na 1 n'ọnụ ụlọ ndị ọrịa na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.angioplasty.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ ha na-arụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime ihe dị ka otu izu, ha nwekwara ike ife ụgbọ elu laa mgbe ụbọchị ole na ole gasịrị.
treatments.angioplasty.faq.0.question: A na-eme ya n'okpuru ọgwụ ụra zuru ezu (general anaesthetic)?
treatments.angioplasty.faq.0.answer: Mba. A na-eme ya n'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu nke ebe ahụ (local anaesthetic), ị na-amụ anya mana ahụ na-eru gị ala.
treatments.angioplasty.faq.1.question: Ọ ga-adị m mkpa ọgwụ ma emechaa?
treatments.angioplasty.faq.1.answer: Ee, ọgwụ na-eme ka ọbara ghara ikpụkọ ọnụ ruo ọnwa ole na ole iji chekwaa stent ahụ, na ọgwụ na-echekwa obi.
treatments.ecmo.name: ECMO (nkwado obi na ngụgụ)
treatments.ecmo.summary: Igwe na-arụ ọrụ obi na ngụgụ ruo ụbọchị ma ọ bụ izu, iji nye ha oge ka ha gbakee.
treatments.ecmo.what: A na-esi n'ọkpọkọ wepụta ọbara, gafee ya na ngụgụ arụrụ arụ nke na-etinye oxygen ma wepụ carbon dioxide, ma gbaghachi ya azụ. A na-eji ya na ngalaba nlekọta pụrụ iche maka ọdịda obi ma ọ bụ ngụgụ kachasị njọ, ma ọ bụ iji kwado ịwa ahụ obi siri ike.
treatments.ecmo.who: Ndị na-arịa ọrịa nke ukwuu nwere ọdịda obi ma ọ bụ ngụgụ siri ike nke ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ anaghị agwọ, dịka mgbe nkụchi obi, oyi baa n'ime ngụgụ (pneumonia) siri ike ma ọ bụ ịwa ahụ obi gasịrị.
treatments.ecmo.stay: Na ngalaba nlekọta pụrụ iche, ruo oge ọ bụla a chọrọ nkwado, ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị ruo izu.
treatments.ecmo.recovery: Ọ dabere n'ọrịa mere ka a chọọ ECMO. Ndị otu dọkịta na-akọwara ezinụlọ nzọụkwụ ọ bụla.
treatments.ecmo.faq.0.question: Enwere ike ibuga onye ọrịa nọ na ECMO na India?
treatments.ecmo.faq.0.answer: N'ọnọdụ ụfọdụ, site n'aka ndị otu ụgbọ elu ụgbọ ọgwụ (air ambulance). Kpọtụrụ anyị ozugbo, anyị ga-ajụ ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ.
treatments.ecmo.faq.1.question: ECMO ọ bụ ọgwụgwọ n'onwe ya?
treatments.ecmo.faq.1.answer: Ọ na-akwado ahụ mgbe obi ma ọ bụ ngụgụ na-agbake, ma ọ bụ ruo mgbe ọgwụgwọ ọzọ, dịka ịwa ahụ, ga-ekwe omume.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.name: Nlekọta obi na ọrịa shuga
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.summary: Nyocha ọkachamara na atụmatụ ọgwụgwọ maka ọrịa obi na ọrịa shuga ọnụ, iji gbochie nkụchi obi na strok.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.what: Dọkịta na-agwọ ọrịa abụọ ahụ na-enyocha akụkọ ahụike gị, nyocha na ọgwụ gị, ma hazie ọgwụgwọ maka shuga ọbara, ọbara mgbali na cholesterol ọnụ. Nyocha nwere ike ịgụnye ECG, echo, nyocha nrụgide obi (stress test) na nyocha ọbara.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.who: Ndị nwere ọrịa shuga, ọbara mgbali elu, cholesterol dị elu ma ọ bụ ọrịa obi n'ezinụlọ, na ndị chọrọ nyocha obi zuru ezu n'oge nleta ha.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: a na-eme nyocha na ndụmọdụ dịka onye ọrịa na-anaghị ehi ụra n'ụlọ ọgwụ, ọ na-abụkarị n'ime ụbọchị 1 ruo 2.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.recovery: Ọ dịghị oge mgbake. Atụmatụ ahụ nwere ike ịga n'ihu na dọkịta gị n'obodo gị.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.faq.0.que: Enwere m ike ime nyocha obi mgbe m nọ na India maka ihe ọzọ?
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.faq.0.ans: Ee. Anyị nwere ike ịdokwa ya n'akụkụ oge nhọpụta gị ndị ọzọ.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.faq.1.que: Ọ ga-adị m mkpa ịgbanwe ọgwụ m?
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.faq.1.ans: Ọ ga-ekwe omume. Dọkịta ga-akọwa mgbanwe ọ bụla ma kesaa atụmatụ ahụ na dọkịta gị n'obodo gị.
treatments.varicose-veins.summary: A na-eji okpomọkụ ma ọ bụ ọgwụ mechie akwara ọbara ụkwụ toro atọ na-afụ ụfụ site n'ime, site n'obere oghere, na-enweghị ịwa ahụ emeghere emeghe.
treatments.varicose-veins.who: Ndị nwere varicose veins na-akpata mgbu, ọzịza, mgbanwe akpụkpọ ahụ ma ọ bụ ọnya, na ụfọdụ ndị nwere deep vein thrombosis.
treatments.varicose-veins.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị, ma ọ bụ abalị 1 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.varicose-veins.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-eje ije ozugbo ma na-alaghachi n'ọrụ ha na-arụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole, na-eyi sọks nkwado ruo otu izu ma ọ bụ abụọ.
treatments.varicose-veins.faq.0.question: Ọ na-afụ ụfụ?
treatments.varicose-veins.faq.0.answer: A na-eme ya n'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu nke ebe ahụ. Obere mgbu ruo ụbọchị ole na ole bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị.
treatments.varicose-veins.faq.1.question: Akwara ọbara ndị ahụ ọ nwere ike ịlọghachi?
treatments.varicose-veins.faq.1.answer: Varicose veins ọhụrụ nwere ike ịpụta ka afọ na-aga, enwekwara ike ịgwọ ha ọzọ.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.nam: Ọgwụgwọ akwara ọbara ụkwụ mechiri emechi
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.sum: A na-eji balloon ma ọ bụ stent site n'obere oghere meghee akwara ọbara ụkwụ dị warara ma ọ bụ mechiri emechi, iji belata mgbu mgbe a na-eje ije ma zọpụta ụkwụ.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.wha: Site n'obere oghere, ọkachamara interventional radiology na-eduzi ọkpọkọ dị gịrịgịrị ruo n'akwara ọbara mechiri emechi, meghee ya na balloon, ma nwee ike itinye stent. Ebe nke a na-agaghị ekwe omume, a pụrụ ịdụ ọdụ ka e mee ịwa ahụ bypass.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.who: Ndị nwere mgbu ụkwụ mgbe ha na-eje ije, mgbu mgbe ha na-ezu ike, ma ọ bụ ọnya na-anaghị agwọ n'ihi na ọbara anaghị eru nke ọma, ọtụtụ mgbe yana ọrịa shuga ma ọ bụ ise siga n'oge gara aga.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.sta: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.rec: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-eje ije n'otu ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ n'echi ya ma na-alaghachi n'ọrụ ha na-arụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime otu izu.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.faq: Ọ nwere ike igbochi ibepụ ụkwụ?
Iweghachi ọbara na-eru nke ọma nwere ike inyere ọnya aka ịgwọ, ọ na-azọpụtakarị ụkwụ. Ka a gwọọ ya n'oge, ka ọ na-adị mma.
Ọ ga-adị m mkpa ọgwụ ma emechaa?
Ee, ọ na-abụkarị ọgwụ na-eme ka ọbara ghara ikpụkọ ọnụ na ọgwụ cholesterol, na enyemaka ịkwụsị ise siga.
treatments.hand-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ aka na iwughachi ya
treatments.hand-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji dozie aka merụrụ ahụ ma ọ bụ mebiri emebi ma weghachi ojiji ya, site n'eriri akwara na akwara ozi bepụrụ ruo n'ijikọghachi mkpịsị aka.
treatments.hand-surgery.what: Dọkịta na-awa aka na-edozi eriri akwara (tendon), akwara ozi, akwara ọbara na ọkpụkpụ n'okpuru maịkrọskop, jikọghachi mkpịsị aka bepụrụ, tọpụ mkpịsị aka siri ike ma ọ bụ gbakọrọ agbakọ, ma were anụ ahụ e si n'ebe ọzọ wepụta wughachi akụkụ na-adịghị. Ọgwụgwọ mmega aka (hand therapy) mgbe e mechara bụ isi akụkụ nke mgbake.
treatments.hand-surgery.who: Ndị merụrụ aka ahụ, ndị akwara ozi ha a na-arụgide dịka carpal tunnel syndrome, ndị nwere mkpịsị aka siri ike ma ọ bụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ndị a mụrụ aka ha dị iche, ma ọ bụ ndị aka ha anaghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma mgbe mmerụ ahụ ochie gasịrị.
treatments.hand-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị site n'usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 3 n'ụlọ ọgwụ, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.hand-surgery.recovery: Site n'izu 2 maka obere ịwa ahụ ruo ọtụtụ ọnwa yana ọgwụgwọ mmega aka maka ndozi siri ike.
treatments.hand-surgery.faq.0.question: Enwere ike ime ka mmerụ ahụ ochie ka mma?
treatments.hand-surgery.faq.0.answer: Ọtụtụ mgbe, ee. Ibufe eriri akwara na akwara ozi nwere ike iweghachi mmegharị ọtụtụ afọ mgbe mmerụ ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.hand-surgery.faq.1.question: Ọ dị m mkpa ọgwụgwọ mmega aka?
treatments.hand-surgery.faq.1.answer: Ee. Ọgwụgwọ mmega dị mkpa dịka ịwa ahụ n'onwe ya maka iweghachi mmegharị.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ brachial plexus na akwara ozi
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.summa: Ịwa ahụ iji dozie akwara ozi si n'olu ruo n'ogwe aka, mgbe mmerụ ahụ gasịrị ma ọ bụ site n'ọmụmụ, iji weghachi mmegharị n'ubu, ogwe aka na aka.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.what: Brachial plexus bụ ùkwù akwara ozi na-achịkwa ogwe aka. N'okpuru maịkrọskop, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-edozi akwara ozi mebiri emebi, na-eji akwara ozi a gbakwụnyere, ma ọ bụ na-ebufe akwara ozi ma ọ bụ anụ ahụ na-arụ ọrụ iji weghachi mmegharị. Oge dị mkpa: akwara ozi na-agbake nke ọma mgbe a dozichara ha n'ime ọnwa ole na ole mgbe mmerụ ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.who: Ndị okenye nwere adịghị ike ogwe aka ma ọ bụ ogwe aka nwụrụ anwụ mgbe ihe mberede okporo ụzọ ma ọ bụ ọdịda gasịrị, na ụmụ ọhụrụ nwere adịghị ike ogwe aka site n'ọmụmụ siri ike (birth brachial plexus palsy).
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.recov: Akwara ozi na-eto nwayọọ, ya mere mmegharị na-alọghachi n'ime ọnwa 6 ruo afọ 2, yana physiotherapy ogologo oge.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.faq.0: Ọ bụ na oge agaala ma ọ bụrụ na mmerụ ahụ ahụ mere otu afọ gara aga?
Ọ bụghị mgbe niile. Ọbụna mgbe ndozi akwara ozi anaghịzi ekwe omume, ibufe akwara ozi ma ọ bụ anụ ahụ ka nwere ike inyere aka.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.faq.1: Olee mgbe a ga-eleta nwa ọhụrụ ahụ?
N'oge kacha mma o kwere omume, ka ọ bụrụ n'ime ọnwa ole na ole mbụ, ka dọkịta na-awa ahụ wee soro mgbake ahụ ma wa ahụ n'oge kwesịrị ekwesị.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.s: Iwughachi akụkụ ahụ mgbe mmerụ ahụ ma ọ bụ ịwa ahụ kansa gasịrị site n'ibufe anụ ahụ, yana ọbara na-eru ya, site n'ebe ọzọ n'ahụ.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.w: A na-ebufe akpụkpọ ahụ, anụ ahụ ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ site n'otu akụkụ ahụ gaa n'ọzọ, a na-ejikọkwa obere akwara ọbara ya n'okpuru maịkrọskop ka ọ dị ndụ. A na-eji ya kpuchie ọnya, wughachi ihu, ara ma ọ bụ agba mgbe ịwa ahụ kansa gasịrị, ma zọpụta ụkwụ merụrụ ahụ nke ukwuu nke a gaara ebepụ.
Ndị nwere nnukwu ọnya ma ọ bụ anụ ahụ na-adịghị mgbe ihe mberede, ọkụ gbara, ọrịa nje ma ọ bụ ịwa ahụ kansa gasịrị, gụnyere mmerụ ụkwụ siri ike.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.s: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 10 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.r: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 4 ruo 8, ogologo karịa maka iwughachi ụkwụ, yana physiotherapy.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.f: Enwere ike ịzọpụta ụkwụ m mgbe mmerụ ahụ siri ike gasịrị?
Ọtụtụ mgbe, ọbụna mgbe mmerụ ahụ siri ike gasịrị. Ndị otu dọkịta na-enyocha ọkpụkpụ, akpụkpọ ahụ na ọbara na-eru ya iji kpebie.
Ọ ga-enwe ọnya n'ebe e si wepụta anụ ahụ ahụ?
Ee, mana dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ahọrọ ebe a na-agaghị ahụ ya nke ukwuu na ebe ọ na-agaghị emetụta ọrụ ahụ nke ukwuu.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ lymphoedema (microsurgery akwara lymph)
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.summary: Microsurgery nke na-enyere mmiri aka isi n'ogwe aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ zara aza gbapụ, ọtụtụ mgbe mgbe ọgwụgwọ kansa gasịrị.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.what: Lymphoedema bụ ọzịza na-apụta mgbe mmiri lymph enweghị ike ịgbapụ. N'okpuru maịkrọskop, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ejikọ obere akwara lymph na obere akwara ọbara ka mmiri wee gbapụ (lymphovenous bypass), ma ọ bụ na-ebufe lymph node dị mma gaa n'akụkụ ahụ zara aza.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.who: Ndị nwere ọzịza ogwe aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ site na lymphoedema, ọtụtụ mgbe mgbe ịwa ahụ kansa ara ma ọ bụ kansa akụkụ nwanyị ma ọ bụ radiotherapy gasịrị, mgbe mkpakọ (compression) na ọgwụgwọ ezughị.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ ha na-arụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime izu 2 ruo 3. Ọzịza na-ebelata nwayọọ nwayọọ n'ime ọnwa, yana ịga n'ihu na mkpakọ.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.faq.0.ans: Ọ na-akakarị mma, ọtụtụ mgbe nke ukwuu, mana o nwere ike ọ gaghị apụ kpamkpam. Ọgwụgwọ n'oge na-eweta nsonaazụ kacha mma.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.faq.1.que: Ọ ka dị m mkpa uwe mkpakọ?
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.faq.1.ans: Ọ na-abụkarị ee ruo oge ụfọdụ mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị. Ọtụtụ mmadụ nwere ike iyi ha obere karịa ka oge na-aga.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.nam: Ịwa ahụ plastik maka ụmụaka na ihe dị iche site n'ọmụmụ
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.sum: Ịwa ahụ maka ụmụaka a mụrụ nwere ihe dị iche dịka egbugbere ọnụ na ọnụ ọnụ gbawara agbawa (cleft), aka dị iche na akara ọmụmụ, ma ọ bụ nwere ọnya site na mmerụ ahụ na ọkụ gbara.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.wha: Dọkịta plastik na-awa ụmụaka ahụ na-edozi egbugbere ọnụ na ọnụ ọnụ gbawara agbawa, kewaa mkpịsị aka jikọrọ ọnụ, dozie ihe ndị ọzọ dị iche n'aka na ihu, ma tọpụ ọnya ọkụ siri ike, n'oge dabara na uto nwa ahụ.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.who: Ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka nwere egbugbere ọnụ ma ọ bụ ọnụ ọnụ gbawara agbawa, aka ma ọ bụ ihu dị iche site n'ọmụmụ, akara ọmụmụ, ma ọ bụ ọnya mgbe mmerụ ahụ na ọkụ gbara gasịrị.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.sta: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.rec: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 1 ruo 3. Ụfọdụ ọnọdụ chọrọ ihe karịrị otu ịwa ahụ ka nwa ahụ na-eto.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.faq: Kedu afọ kacha mma maka ịwa ahụ?
Ọ dabere n'ọnọdụ ahụ. A na-edozikarị egbugbere ọnụ gbawara agbawa mgbe nwa dị ihe dị ka ọnwa 3 ruo 6, ọnụ ọnụ gbawara agbawa tupu ihe dị ka ọnwa 18.
Nne ma ọ bụ nna ọ nwere ike ịnọnyere nwa ahụ?
Ee. Otu n'ime ndị nne na nna na-anọnyere nwa ahụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ oge niile.
treatments.rhinoplasty.name: Rhinoplasty (imezi ọdịdị imi)
treatments.rhinoplasty.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji gbanwee ọdịdị ma ọ bụ nha imi, maka ọdịdị, maka iku ume, ma ọ bụ ha abụọ.
treatments.rhinoplasty.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-emezi ọkpụkpụ na cartilage imi, ọ na-abụkarị site n'ọnya n'ime imi ma ọ bụ obere ọnya n'etiti oghere imi abụọ. Enwere ike ime ka septum gbagọrọ agbagọ kwụ ọtọ n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ iji nyere iku ume aka.
treatments.rhinoplasty.who: Ndị okenye chọrọ ịgbanwe ọdịdị imi ha, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere nsogbu iku ume site na septum gbagọrọ agbagọ ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ gara aga.
treatments.rhinoplasty.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ abalị 1 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.rhinoplasty.recovery: Ihe nkwado (splint) na-anọ ihe dị ka otu izu. Ọtụtụ ọzịza na ọnya ojii na-ada n'ime izu 2, ọdịdị ikpeazụ na-apụtakwa n'ime ọnwa.
treatments.rhinoplasty.faq.0.question: Olee mgbe m ga-efe ụgbọ elu laa?
treatments.rhinoplasty.faq.0.answer: Ọ na-abụkarị mgbe ihe dị ka ụbọchị 7 ruo 10 gasịrị, ozugbo e wepụrụ ihe nkwado ahụ.
treatments.rhinoplasty.faq.1.question: Ọ ga-edozikwa iku ume m?
treatments.rhinoplasty.faq.1.answer: Ọ bụrụ na nsogbu ahụ bụ septum gbagọrọ agbagọ, enwere ike idozi ya n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ.
treatments.liposuction.name: Liposuction (iwepụ abụba)
treatments.liposuction.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-ewepụ abụba site n'akụkụ ahụ a họọrọ site n'obere ọnya. Ọ na-emezi ọdịdị ahụ; ọ bụghị ọgwụgwọ maka ibelata ibu.
treatments.liposuction.what: A na-atọpụ abụba ma wepụ ya site n'ọkpọkọ dị gịrịgịrị a na-etinye site n'obere ọnya, site n'akụkụ dịka afọ, apata ụkwụ, ogwe aka ma ọ bụ olu. A na-eyi uwe mkpakọ mgbe e mechara iji nyere akpụkpọ ahụ aka ịdakọ.
treatments.liposuction.who: Ndị okenye nwere ibu dị nso n'ibu kwesịrị ekwesị nwere akụkụ abụba na-anaghị apụ site na nri na mmega ahụ.
treatments.liposuction.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ abalị 1 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.liposuction.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ ọfịs n'ime otu izu. Ọzịza na-ada n'ime izu ruo ọnwa.
treatments.liposuction.faq.0.question: Ọ bụ ụzọ isi belata ibu?
treatments.liposuction.faq.0.answer: Mba. Ọ na-emezi ọdịdị ahụ. Maka ibu buru ibu, ịwa ahụ ibelata ibu nwere ike ịdaba karịa.
treatments.liposuction.faq.1.question: Abụba ahụ ọ ga-alọghachi?
treatments.liposuction.faq.1.answer: Mkpụrụ abụba e wepụrụ anaghị alọghachi, mana ibu ịrị elu nwere ike itinye abụba n'ebe ọzọ.
treatments.hair-transplant.summary: A na-ebufe mgbọrọgwụ ntutu isi otu otu site n'azụ ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ isi gaa n'ebe ntutu dị ole na ole ma ọ bụ isi kwọrọ akwọ.
treatments.hair-transplant.what: N'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu nke ebe ahụ, a na-ewepụta mgbọrọgwụ ntutu dị mma otu otu site n'azụ ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ isi (follicular unit extraction) ma tinye ha n'ebe ntutu dị ole na ole. Ọ na-ewe ihe ka ukwuu n'otu ụbọchị.
treatments.hair-transplant.who: Ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị nwere ntutu isi na-apụ n'usoro ma ọ bụ na-agịrịgịrị, ndị nwere ntutu dị mma zuru ezu n'azụ na n'akụkụ isi.
treatments.hair-transplant.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ọ bụ usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị.
treatments.hair-transplant.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ ha na-arụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole. Ntutu ọhụrụ ahụ na-ebu ụzọ daa, ma tolite ọzọ n'ime ọnwa 3 ruo 12.
treatments.hair-transplant.faq.0.questio: Olee mgbe m ga-ahụ nsonaazụ ya?
treatments.hair-transplant.faq.0.answer: Ntutu ọhụrụ na-amalite ito n'ime ihe dị ka ọnwa 3 ruo 4, nsonaazụ zuru ezu na-apụta mgbe ihe dị ka otu afọ gasịrị.
treatments.hair-transplant.faq.1.questio: Enwere m ike ife ụgbọ elu laa n'echi ya?
treatments.hair-transplant.faq.1.answer: Ọ na-abụkarị ee, mgbe e nyochachara ebe a gwọrọ.
treatments.cataract-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ cataract nwere lens ọkaibe (IOL)
treatments.cataract-surgery.summary: A na-ewepụ lens anya nkịtị gbachiri agbachi ma jiri lens arụrụ arụ doro anya dochie ya.
treatments.cataract-surgery.what: Site n'obere ọnya, a na-eji ultrasound (phacoemulsification) ma ọ bụ site n'enyemaka laser femtosecond kụrie lens gbachiri agbachi, ma tinye lens arụrụ arụ a pịarala apịa (IOL) n'ọnọdụ ya. Lens ọkaibe nwekwara ike idozi astigmatism ma ọ bụ nye ọhụhụ doro anya n'ihe karịrị otu anya ebe. Anya ọ bụla na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 15 ruo 30, n'okpuru ọgwụ mmiri anya na-eme ka ọ ghara ịma mgbu.
treatments.cataract-surgery.who: Ndị cataract ha na-eme ka ọhụhụ ha gbachie, dị ọchịchịrị ma ọ bụ na-enwu ọkụ ruo n'ịkpaghasị ndụ ha kwa ụbọchị.
treatments.cataract-surgery.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ọ bụ usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.cataract-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-ahụ ụzọ nke ọma n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole ma na-alaghachi na ndụ kwa ụbọchị dị mfe n'ime otu izu. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka otu izu mgbe anya mbụ gasịrị; a na-emekarị anya nke abụọ ụbọchị ole na ole ka e mesịrị.
treatments.cataract-surgery.faq.0.questi: Enwere ike ime anya abụọ n'otu njem?
treatments.cataract-surgery.faq.0.answer: Ọ na-abụkarị ee. A na-emekarị anya nke abụọ ụbọchị ole na ole ruo otu izu mgbe nke mbụ gasịrị, ozugbo e nyochara anya mbụ.
treatments.cataract-surgery.faq.1.questi: Ọ ka ga-adị m mkpa iyi enyo anya?
treatments.cataract-surgery.faq.1.answer: Ọ dabere na lens ị họọrọ. Lens ọkaibe nwere ike ibelata mkpa enyo anya; dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-akọwa nhọrọ ndị ahụ mgbe ọ tụchara anya gị.
treatments.lasik.name: LASIK, Femto-LASIK na ndozi ọhụhụ laser CLEAR
treatments.lasik.summary: Laser na-emezi ihu anya doro anya (cornea) ka enyo anya ma ọ bụ contact lens ghara ịdị mkpa ọzọ.
treatments.lasik.what: A na-eji laser emezi cornea ka ìhè wee daba nke ọma na retina. Na LASIK na Femto-LASIK na-enweghị mma, a na-ebuli obere mpempe dị gịrịgịrị tupu laser arụọ ọrụ; na CLEAR, a na-ewepụ obere anụ ahụ site n'obere oghere na-enweghị mpempe. A na-agwọkarị anya abụọ n'otu oge, nke na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 15 ruo 30, n'okpuru ọgwụ mmiri anya na-eme ka ọ ghara ịma mgbu.
treatments.lasik.who: Ndị okenye karịrị afọ 18 ndị ike enyo anya ha anọgidela n'otu ọnọdụ ma ọ dịkarịa ala otu afọ, nwere anya dị mma na cornea gbara oke zuru ezu maka ọgwụgwọ ahụ. Nyocha zuru ezu na-ekpebi usoro dabara gị.
treatments.lasik.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ọ bụ usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.lasik.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-ahụ ụzọ nke ọma n'ime otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ abụọ ma na-alaghachi n'ọrụ n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka otu izu maka nyocha nsoro.
treatments.lasik.faq.0.question: Ọ na-afụ ụfụ?
treatments.lasik.faq.0.answer: Mba. A na-eji ọgwụ mmiri anya na-eme ka ọ ghara ịma mgbu, ọtụtụ mmadụ na-enwe naanị obere nrụgide. Anya nwere ike ịdị ka ájá dị n'ime ya ruo otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ karịa ntakịrị mgbe e mechara.
treatments.lasik.faq.1.question: Kedu ka m ga-esi mara usoro laser dabara m?
treatments.lasik.faq.1.answer: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ekpebi mgbe nyocha cornea gị gasịrị. Akụkọ nyocha gị si n'obodo gị na-enyere anyị aka inye gị echiche mbụ tupu ị gaa njem.
treatments.icl.name: Implantable Collamer Lens (ICL)
treatments.icl.summary: A na-etinye lens dị gịrịgịrị n'ime anya iji dozie ike enyo anya dị elu, maka ndị na-enweghị ike ime ọgwụgwọ laser.
treatments.icl.what: Site n'obere ọnya, a na-etinye lens dị nro, dị gịrịgịrị n'ime anya n'ihu lens nkịtị. A na-edebe lens nkịtị ahụ, enwekwara ike iwepụ ICL ahụ ma emechaa ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa. Anya ọ bụla na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 20 ruo 30, n'okpuru ọgwụ mmiri anya na-eme ka ọ ghara ịma mgbu.
treatments.icl.who: Ndị okenye nwere nnukwu nsogbu ọhụhụ ihe dị anya (short-sight) ma ọ bụ astigmatism, ma ọ bụ cornea dị gịrịgịrị nke ukwuu maka LASIK.
treatments.icl.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ọ bụ usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.icl.recovery: Ọhụhụ na-akakarị mma n'ime otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ abụọ. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka otu izu maka nyocha.
treatments.icl.faq.0.question: Enwere m ike ịma lens ahụ n'anya m?
treatments.icl.faq.0.answer: Mba. Lens ahụ na-anọ n'ime anya, a pụghịkwa ịma ya ozugbo ọ nọ n'ọnọdụ ya.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ keratoconus (corneal cross-linking)
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.summary: Ọgwụgwọ na-akwụsị cornea na-agịrịgịrị, nke dị ka ọdịdị kọn, ịka njọ, ma na-eji lens pụrụ iche enyere ọhụhụ aka.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.what: Na corneal cross-linking, a na-etinye ọgwụ mmiri anya vitamin B2 (riboflavin) n'anya ma emesịa chakwasị ya ìhè ultraviolet a tụrụ atụ. Nke a na-ewusi cornea ike ma kwụsị kọn ahụ ịka kpọọ. Contact lens pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ lens a kụnyere n'anya nwere ike ime ka ọhụhụ ka mma.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.who: Ụmụaka na ndị okenye keratoconus ha na-aka njọ, dịka a hụrụ na nyocha cornea a na-emeghachi.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ọ bụ usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.recover: Anya na-afụ ụfụ ruo ụbọchị ole na ole ka elu ya na-agwọ. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka otu izu maka nyocha.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.faq.0.a: Isi ebumnuche ya bụ ịkwụsị keratoconus ịka njọ. A na-ejizi lens enyere ọhụhụ aka; dọkịta ga-akọwa ihe ị ga-atụ anya ya maka anya gị.
treatments.corneal-transplant.name: Ịkụnye cornea (keratoplasty)
treatments.corneal-transplant.summary: A na-eji anụ ahụ dị mma e nwetara n'aka onye nyere onyinye dochie cornea mebiri emebi ma ọ bụ nwere ọnya, kpamkpam ma ọ bụ n'akwa n'akwa.
treatments.corneal-transplant.what: A na-ewepụ akụkụ cornea mebiri emebi ma jiri anụ ahụ doro anya sitere n'anya onye nyere onyinye dochie ya. Dabere na nsogbu ahụ, a na-edochi oke ya niile ma ọ bụ naanị akwa dị n'ihu ma ọ bụ n'azụ. Anụ ahụ onyinye na-esite n'ụlọ akụ anya a kwadoro.
treatments.corneal-transplant.who: Ndị nwere cornea nwere ọnya, gbachiri agbachi ma ọ bụ gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ukwuu, dịka site n'ọrịa nje, mmerụ ahụ ma ọ bụ keratoconus kara njọ.
treatments.corneal-transplant.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ otu abalị n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.corneal-transplant.recovery: Ọhụhụ na-aka mma nwayọọ nwayọọ n'ime ọnwa. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka izu 2 ruo 3 maka nyocha nso nso, na iji ọgwụ mmiri anya ogologo oge mgbe e mechara.
treatments.corneal-transplant.faq.0.ques: Ebee ka cornea onyinye ahụ si?
treatments.corneal-transplant.faq.0.answ: Site n'ụlọ akụ anya. Na India, a pụrụ ime ịkụnye cornea naanị n'ụlọ ọgwụ a kwadoro maka ya n'okpuru iwu India.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ glaucoma
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.summary: Ọgwụ mmiri anya, laser ma ọ bụ ịwa ahụ iji belata nrụgide dị n'ime anya ma chekwaa ọhụhụ pụọ na glaucoma.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.what: Glaucoma na-emebi nwayọọ nwayọọ akwara ozi dị n'azụ anya, ọ na-abụkarị n'ihi na nrụgide dị n'ime anya dị elu nke ukwuu. Ọgwụgwọ na-ebelata nrụgide ahụ: nke mbụ site n'ọgwụ mmiri anya, emesịa site na laser, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa site n'ịwa ahụ nke na-emepụta ụzọ ọhụrụ mmiri dị n'anya ga-esi gbapụ.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.who: Ndị a chọpụtara na ha nwere glaucoma, ma ọ bụ nwere nrụgide anya dị elu nke na-etinye ọhụhụ ha n'ihe ize ndụ.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ maka laser; usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ otu abalị maka ịwa ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.recovery: Laser chọrọ naanị obere izu ike. Mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị, kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka izu 2 maka nyocha.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.faq.0.ques: Enwere ike ịgbanwe mmebi glaucoma mere?
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.faq.0.answ: Mba. Ọhụhụ furu efu enweghị ike ịlọghachi, ọ bụ ya mere ọgwụgwọ ji bụrụ maka ichekwa ọhụhụ fọdụrụ.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ retina na vitreo-retinal
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.summary: Laser, ọgwụ a na-agba n'agịga ma ọ bụ ịwa ahụ maka nsogbu dị n'azụ anya, dịka retina tọpụrụ atọpụ ma ọ bụ ọrịa anya ọrịa shuga na-akpata.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.what: Dabere na nsogbu ahụ, a na-eji laser gwọọ retina, site n'ọgwụ a na-agba n'ime anya, ma ọ bụ site na vitrectomy: a na-ewepụ jelii dị n'ime anya ka dọkịta na-awa ahụ wee dozie retina. A na-eweghachi retina tọpụrụ atọpụ n'ọnọdụ ya ma jiri gas ma ọ bụ mmanụ jide ya.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.who: Ndị nwere retina tọpụrụ atọpụ ma ọ bụ dọwara adọwa, ọbara ọgbụgba n'ime anya, ọrịa anya ọrịa shuga na-akpata, oghere macula ma ọ bụ mmebi macula metụtara agadi.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị; mgbe ụfọdụ otu abalị n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.recover: Mgbake dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Mgbe vitrectomy gasịrị, ọ nwere ike ịdị gị mkpa idebe isi gị n'otu ọnọdụ ruo ụbọchị ụfọdụ, ị gaghịkwa enwe ike ife ụgbọ elu mgbe gas ka dị n'anya. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka izu 2 ruo 3.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.faq.0.q: Olee mgbe m ga-efe ụgbọ elu laa?
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.faq.0.a: Ọ bụghị mgbe afụ gas ka dị n'anya, nke nwere ike iwe izu ole na ole. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-agwa gị mgbe ọ dị nchebe.
treatments.squint-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ anya ngọngọ na nlekọta anya ụmụaka
treatments.squint-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ akwara anụ ahụ anya iji mee ka anya na-atụgharị n'ime, n'èzí, n'elu ma ọ bụ n'ala kwụ ọtọ, maka ụmụaka na ndị okenye.
treatments.squint-surgery.what: A na-eme ka akwara anụ ahụ na-emegharị anya sie ike ma ọ bụ tọpụ ntakịrị ka anya abụọ ahụ wee kwụ ọtọ ọnụ. A na-enyochakwa ọhụhụ ụmụaka maka anya umengwụ (lazy eye) na enyo anya tupu a hazie ịwa ahụ ọ bụla.
treatments.squint-surgery.who: Ụmụaka na ndị okenye nwere anya ngọngọ nke enyo anya ma ọ bụ mmega anya edozibeghị.
treatments.squint-surgery.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ọ bụ usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.squint-surgery.recovery: Anya na-acha ọbara ọbara ma na-afụ ụfụ ruo otu izu ma ọ bụ abụọ. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka otu izu.
treatments.squint-surgery.faq.0.question: A na-eme ịwa ahụ ahụ n'okpuru ọgwụ ụra zuru ezu (general anaesthetic)?
treatments.squint-surgery.faq.0.answer: Maka ụmụaka, ọ na-abụkarị ee. Ndị okenye nwere ike mgbe ụfọdụ ime ya n'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu nke ebe ahụ.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ oculoplastic
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ maka nkpuchi anya, ọwa anya mmiri na ọkpụkpụ gbara anya gburugburu.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.what: Ịwa ahụ nkpuchi anya (dịka nkpuchi anya dara ada ma ọ bụ nkpuchi anya na-atụgharị n'ime ma ọ bụ n'èzí), usoro anya mmiri si agbapụ (dịka ọwa anya mmiri mechiri emechi) na oghere anya, gụnyere iwepụ ihe toro na iwughachi mgbe mmerụ ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.who: Ndị nwere nsogbu nkpuchi anya, ọwa anya mmiri ma ọ bụ oghere anya, maka ihe gbasara ahụike ma ọ bụ ịma mma.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị usoro a na-eme n'otu ụbọchị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.recovery: Ọzịza na ọnya ojii na-ada n'ime izu 1 ruo 2. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka otu izu ruo ụbọchị 10, ruo mgbe e wepụrụ eri a kpara akpa.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.faq.0.qu: Ọ ga-enwe ọnya a na-ahụ anya?
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.faq.0.an: A na-ezokarị ọnya ndị ahụ n'ime mpịaji nkịtị nke nkpuchi anya, ya mere ọ na-esi ike ịhụ ọnya mgbe ọ gwọchara.
treatments.dental-implants.name: Ịkụnye eze (dental implants)
treatments.dental-implants.summary: A na-etinye mkpọ titanium n'agba iji jide eze ọhụrụ ebe eze na-adịghị.
treatments.dental-implants.what: A na-etinye obere mkpọ titanium n'ọkpụkpụ agba n'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu nke ebe ahụ. Ozugbo ọkpụkpụ toro gbaa ya gburugburu, a na-eketa crown, bridge ma ọ bụ eze arụrụ arụ n'elu ya. N'ọnọdụ ụfọdụ, enwere ike inye eze nwa oge n'otu ụbọchị ahụ.
treatments.dental-implants.who: Ndị okenye nwere otu eze ma ọ bụ karịa na-adịghị na ọkpụkpụ agba dị mma zuru ezu, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere ike ibu ụzọ nweta ọkpụkpụ a gbakwụnyere.
treatments.dental-implants.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: nleta ọ bụla bụ nhọpụta n'ụlọ ọgwụ eze. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.dental-implants.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi na ndụ nkịtị n'echi ya. Ọkpụkpụ na-ewe ihe dị ka ọnwa 3 ruo 6 iji gwọọ gburugburu implant ahụ, ya mere a na-ekekarị ọgwụgwọ ahụ n'ime njem abụọ, belụsọ ma dọkịta eze nwere ike itinye eze ikpeazụ ngwa ngwa.
treatments.dental-implants.faq.0.questio: Enwere ike ime ya n'otu njem?
treatments.dental-implants.faq.0.answer: Mgbe ụfọdụ. Ọ dabere n'ọkpụkpụ gị na ụdị implant. Dọkịta eze ga-agwa gị mgbe ọ hụchara X-ray gị.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ root canal
treatments.root-canal-treatment.summary: A na-asachapụ ma mechie ime eze butere ọrịa nje, ka e wee nwee ike idebe eze ahụ kama ịwepụ ya.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.what: N'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu nke ebe ahụ, a na-ewepụ pulp butere ọrịa nje ma ọ bụ mebiri emebi dị n'ime eze, sachaa ma hazie ọwa ya, ma mejupụta ma mechie ha. A na-etinyekarị crown mgbe e mechara iji chekwaa eze ahụ.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.who: Ndị nwere eze rere ure nke ukwuu, gbawara agbawa ma ọ bụ butere ọrịa nje nke na-akpata mgbu ma ọ bụ ọzịza.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ọ na-abụkarị nleta 1 ruo 3 n'ụlọ ọgwụ eze. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.recovery: Eze ahụ nwere ike ịdị nro ruo ụbọchị ole na ole. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'iri nri nkịtị n'ime otu izu.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.faq.0.an: A na-eme ya n'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu nke ebe ahụ, ya mere ọ kwesịrị ịdị ka imejupụta eze nkịtị.
treatments.smile-design.name: Imezi ọchị na ọgwụgwọ eze maka ịma mma
treatments.smile-design.summary: Veneer, ime ka eze cha ọcha na ihe mejupụta eze nwere agba eze iji mee ka ọchị gị ka mma.
treatments.smile-design.what: Dọkịta eze na-ahazi ọdịdị, nha na agba eze gị, ma jiri veneer ma ọ bụ laminate, ime ka eze cha ọcha, ihe mejupụta eze nwere agba eze ma ọ bụ crown nweta ọdịdị ahụ.
treatments.smile-design.who: Ndị chọrọ ịgbanwe eze nwere ntụpọ, gbajiri agbaji, na-adịghị nhata ma ọ bụ nwere oghere n'etiti ha.
treatments.smile-design.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ọ na-abụkarị nleta ole na ole n'ụlọ ọgwụ eze n'ime izu 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.smile-design.recovery: Ọ dịghị oge mgbake maka ọtụtụ ọgwụgwọ. Eze nwere ike ịdị nro ruo ụbọchị ole na ole.
treatments.smile-design.faq.0.question: Ogologo oge ole ka veneer na-adịgide?
treatments.smile-design.faq.0.answer: Veneer porcelain na-adịgidekarị afọ 10 ma ọ bụ karịa ma ọ bụrụ na e lekọta ha nke ọma.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.sum: Usoro ọgwụgwọ a haziri ahazi nke na-ewughachi eze niile mgbe ọtụtụ n'ime ha gbasasịrị, gbajiri agbaji ma ọ bụ na-adịghị.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.wha: A na-ahazi ngwakọta crown, bridge, implant, ọgwụgwọ root canal na nlekọta chịngọm ọnụ iji wughachi ka eze si ezute onwe ha na ọdịdị eze.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.who: Ndị nwere ọtụtụ eze mebiri emebi ma ọ bụ na-adịghị, eze gbasasịrị agbasa, ma ọ bụ nsogbu site n'ọtụtụ ọgwụgwọ ochie.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.sta: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: usoro nleta n'ụlọ ọgwụ eze. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.rec: Ọ dabere n'atụmatụ ahụ. Enwere ike ime ụfọdụ ọrụ n'otu njem nke izu 1 ruo 2; atụmatụ nwere implant nwere ike ịchọ njem nke abụọ.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.faq: Njem ole ka ọ ga-adị m mkpa?
Dọkịta eze na-ahazi atụmatụ ahụ mgbe ọ hụchara X-ray gị ma gwa gị nleta ole dị mkpa.
treatments.braces-aligners.name: Braces na clear aligners
treatments.braces-aligners.summary: Braces ma ọ bụ clear aligners na-akwaga eze nwayọọ nwayọọ ka ha kwụ ọtọ.
treatments.braces-aligners.what: Braces a kegidere ekegide ma ọ bụ clear aligners a na-ewepụ ewepụ na-etinye nrụgide dị nro iji kwaga eze n'ime ọnwa. Dọkịta eze na-eme nyocha ma ọ bụ were ọdịdị eze ma hazie nzọụkwụ ọ bụla.
treatments.braces-aligners.who: Ụmụaka na ndị okenye nwere eze gbagọrọ agbagọ, kpakọrọ ọnụ ma ọ bụ nwere oghere, ma ọ bụ eze elu na nke ala na-anaghị ezute nke ọma.
treatments.braces-aligners.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: nleta n'ụlọ ọgwụ eze. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.braces-aligners.recovery: Ọgwụgwọ na-ewekarị ọnwa 6 ruo 24. Na aligners, enwere ike ime ọtụtụ nyocha site n'obodo gị mgbe nleta mbụ gasịrị.
treatments.braces-aligners.faq.0.questio: Enwere ike ịgwọ m ma ọ bụrụ na m bi ná mba ọzọ?
treatments.braces-aligners.faq.0.answer: Ọtụtụ mgbe ee na clear aligners: nleta mbụ bụ ihu na ihu, enwekwara ike iziga gị aligners ndị ọzọ ma emechaa.

hospitals.kenia-eye.overview: Ụlọ ọgwụ anya ọkachamara dị na Santacruz, Mumbai, nke na-elekọta ndị ọrịa kemgbe 1998. Dr. Vaishal Kenia, dọkịta na-awa cataract na ndozi ọhụhụ (refractive), na-edu ya, yana otu ndị dọkịta na ndị ndụmọdụ na-ekpuchi akụkụ ọ bụla nke nlekọta anya. A kwadoro ya maka ịkụnye cornea, o nwekwara laser FEMTO Z8 NEO na-enweghị mma, nke mbụ na Western India, yana igwe nyocha dị elu dịka IOL Master 700, Pentacam, Verion na onyonyo retina OPTOS sara mbara nke ukwuu. Ọ na-agwọ ihe niile site na cataract na LASIK ruo na cornea, glaucoma, retina, anya ngọngọ na nsogbu nkpuchi anya. Kenia Dental Clinic, nke Dr. Pallavi Kenia na-elekọta, dị n'otu ụlọ ahụ.

posts.bilateral-hand-transplant-nanavati: Ịkụnye aka abụọ weghachiri nwa okorobịa dị afọ 18 aka ya
Otu nwa okorobịa onye ọrụ ugbo nke tụfuru aka ya abụọ n'ihe mberede natara aka abụọ e nyere n'onyinye n'ịwa ahụ were awa 13 na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mumbai.
Na Jenụwarị 2024, nwa nwoke onye ọrụ ugbo dị afọ 18 si Gujarat tụfuru aka ya abụọ n'ihe mberede igwe ọrụ ugbo. Mmerụ ahụ ahụ siri ike nke ukwuu idozi, a ghaghịkwa ibepụ aka abụọ ahụ.
Mgbe nyocha ahụike, nke uche na nke usoro mgbochi ọrịa zuru ezu gasịrị, ndị dọkịta kpebiri na ọ dabara maka ịkụnye aka abụọ. Aka onyinye dị ụkọ, ha ga-ekwekọrịta nke ọma, ya mere o chere ọnwa 13.

Na Jenụwarị 2026, ezinụlọ otu nwanyị dị afọ 50 nwụrụ na Surat kwetara inye akụkụ ahụ ya n'onyinye. Ngụgụ ya, imeju ya na cornea ya gara n'aka ndị ọrịa na Mumbai na Surat, aka ya abụọ gakwara n'aka ya. Ndị otu na Gujarat na Maharashtra rụkọrọ ọrụ ọnụ iji bubata aka ndị ahụ na Mumbai n'obere oge dịnụ.

Ịwa ahụ ahụ mere n'abalị 9 ruo 10 Jenụwarị 2026, nke Dr Nilesh Satbhai, Director nke Ịwa Ahụ Plastik, Microsurgery Iwughachi Ahụ na Ịkụnye Aka, duru. N'ime awa 13, ndị otu ahụ jikọrọ ọkpụkpụ, jikọọ akwara ọbara niile, dozie eriri akwara (tendon), jikọọ akwara ozi ma mechie akpụkpọ ahụ. Ọbara banyere n'aka abụọ ahụ ozugbo e jikọrọ akwara ọbara.

Mgbe e mechara, otu ndị nlekọta lekọtara ya, ndị jikwara ọgwụ iji gbochie ahụ ịjụ aka ndị ahụ, lekọta ọbara na-eru ha nke ọma, gbochie ọrịa nje ma malite ọgwụgwọ mgbake n'oge. Ọ bụ ịkụnye aka abụọ mbụ na Nanavati Max.

Ịkụnye aka siri ike karịa ịkụnye akụkụ ahụ dị n'ime, n'ihi na ọ na-ebufe akpụkpọ ahụ, anụ ahụ, eriri akwara, ọkpụkpụ, akwara ọbara na akwara ozi ọnụ, ahụ na-ajụkwa akpụkpọ ahụ ọzọ nke ukwuu. Mgbe ọ rụrụ ọrụ, ọ nwere ike iweghachi mmetụta na mmegharị a haziri ahazi nke aka arụrụ arụ na-enweghị ike inye.
Ọ bụrụ na gị ma ọ bụ onye n'ezinụlọ gị atụfuola aka ma ọ bụ ogwe aka, ziga anyị akụkọ ahụike ya. Ọkachamara ga-agwa gị ma ịkụnye ma ọ bụ iwughachi nwere ike inyere aka.
Onye ọrịa ahụ na ndị dọkịta, ndị nọọsụ na ndị ọrụ Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital lekọtara ya
Max Healthcare: Ịkụnye aka abụọ site n'aka nwanyị nyere onyinye gaa n'aka nwoke natara ya
posts.thumb-reconstruction-toddler-nanav: A mụrụ ya na-enweghị isi mkpịsị aka: otu ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ siri wughachi ijide aka nwatakịrị
Nwa nwanyị ọhụrụ a mụrụ nwere nnukwu nkwarụ isi mkpịsị aka n'aka abụọ nwere ike ijide ma jigide ihe ugbu a, mgbe ịwa ahụ abụọ gasịrị na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mumbai.

A mụrụ otu nwatakịrị nwanyị na-enweghị isi mkpịsị aka ekpe, isi mkpịsị aka nri ya etozughịkwa nke ọ ga-eji ya. Na-enweghị isi mkpịsị aka na-arụ ọrụ, nwatakịrị na-enwe nsogbu ịmụta ijide, ịkpachi na ijigide ihe.

Dr Nilesh G Satbhai, Director nke Ịwa Ahụ Plastik, Microsurgery Iwughachi Ahụ na Ịkụnye Aka, na ndị otu ya haziri ịwa ahụ abụọ. Akwara ọbara na akwara ozi ya dị nnọọ ntakịrị, nke mere ka ọrụ ahụ chọọ nlezianya, ebe ọ bụkwa na aka abụọ metụtara, ịwa ahụ abụọ ahụ ga-aga nke ọma.

Ịwa ahụ mbụ, na Disemba 2025, mere ka isi mkpịsị aka nri na-esighị ike guzosie ike ma bufee otu anụ ahụ site n'ọbụ aka ya ka isi mkpịsị aka ahụ wee nwee ike ịtụgharị ma metụ mkpịsị aka ndị ọzọ. N'ime izu ole na ole, ọ malitere iji ya.

Nke abụọ, na Febụwarị 2026, wuru isi mkpịsị aka ekpe ọhụrụ site n'ibufe mkpịsị ụkwụ nke abụọ site n'ụkwụ ekpe ya gaa n'aka ya ma jikọọ akwara ọbara ya, akwara ozi ya na eriri akwara ya n'okpuru maịkrọskop. Ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ wughachikwara ụkwụ ahụ ka ọ nọgide na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma.
Mgbe ọ dị ọnwa 13, ọ nwere ike ijide mkpịsị aka nne na nna ya. Ịwa ahụ dị otu a na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'oge, mgbe nwatakịrị ka na-amụta iji aka ya.
Ọ bụrụ na a mụrụ nwa gị nwere aka dị iche, ziga anyị foto na akụkọ ahụike ọ bụla. Ọkachamara ga-adụ ọdụ ihe a pụrụ ime na mgbe a ga-eme ya.

privacy.sections.0.heading: 1. Mmalite
privacy.sections.0.body.0: Medsafar India ("Medsafar", "anyị", "nke anyị") kwere nkwa ichebe nzuzo, ihe nzuzo na nchekwa nke ozi onwe nke ndị na-eleta weebụsaịtị anyị, na-eziga ajụjụ, na-edebanye aha n'aka anyị, ma ọ bụ na-eji ọrụ anyị nke nhazi njem maka ọgwụgwọ na nhazi ndị ọrịa.
privacy.sections.0.body.1: Iwu Nzuzo a na-akọwa otu anyị si anakọta, jiri, chekwaa, hazie, kpughee ma chebe ozi onwe, gụnyere ozi ahụike dị nro, n'ihe metụtara weebụsaịtị anyị na ọrụ anyị.
privacy.sections.0.body.2: Medsafar India na-eme ka ọ dị mfe inweta ọrụ ahụike site n'ịhazi ihe na ụlọ ọgwụ, ndị dọkịta, ebe nyocha na ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ metụtara ya. Anyị ghọtara na ozi ahụike bụ ihe nzuzo, anyị kwekwara nkwa iji ya n'ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị na n'ụzọ doro anya.
privacy.sections.0.body.3: Iwu Nzuzo a metụtara ndị na-eleta weebụsaịtị, ndị nwere ike ịbụ ndị ọrịa, ndị ọrịa debanyere aha, ndị na-elekọta ha ma ọ bụ ndị nnọchiteanya ha nwere ikike, na ndị ọzọ na-eso ọrụ anyị emekọ ihe.
privacy.sections.0.body.4: Otu anyị si eji ozi onwe dabere n'iwu India dị ugbu a, gụnyere Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, ruo n'ókè ọ metụtara ma na-arụ ọrụ, Information Technology Act, 2000, na usoro na ụkpụrụ ndị metụtara ya.
privacy.sections.1.heading: 2. Ozi Anyị Na-anakọta
privacy.sections.1.body.0: Ozi Onwe na Ozi Nkwurịta Okwu: Aha zuru ezu na aha nsọpụrụ; adreesị email; nọmba ekwentị na WhatsApp; obodo ebe ị bi na mba i si, ebe a chọrọ ya; afọ ndụ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ọmụmụ; nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị, ebe ọ metụtara ọrụ a rịọrọ; adreesị ebe obibi ma ọ bụ nke ozi; na asụsụ ị họọrọ na otu i si achọ ka anyị kpọtụrụ gị.
privacy.sections.1.body.1: Ozi Ahụike: Akụkọ ahụike na nkọwa ọrịa ndị dị adị; mgbaàmà na ọgwụgwọ achọrọ; akwụkwọ nyocha ahụike, nsonaazụ ụlọ nyocha na foto nyocha (scan); akwụkwọ ọgwụ na ndetu ndị dọkịta; nkọwa ọhụhụ dọkịta, ịwa ahụ ma ọ bụ ọgwụgwọ gara aga; foto ma ọ bụ ndekọ ahụike ndị ọzọ, ebe ọ metụtara ya ma e nye ya n'afọ ofufo; na ozi ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ dọkịta na-agwọ gị chọrọ iji tụlee arịrịọ ọgwụgwọ.
privacy.sections.1.body.2: Anyị na-arịọ ozi ahụike naanị mgbe ọ dị mkpa n'ezie maka ọrụ a na-achọ, anyị na-ejikwa nchekwa nzuzo kwesịrị ekwesị elekọta ya.
privacy.sections.1.body.3: Ozi Njem na Ebe Obibi: Nkọwa paspọtụ na akwụkwọ njem ndị ọzọ, ebe ọ dị mkpa; ụbọchị njem na otu i si achọ ka e hazie njem gị; ihe ị chọrọ gbasara ụgbọelu na ebe obibi; nkọwa ndị ezinụlọ ma ọ bụ ndị na-elekọta gị ga-eso gị; ozi metụtara visa; na enyemaka pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ ihe ị chọrọ iji nwee ike ịga njem ahụ n'ụzọ dị mfe.
privacy.sections.1.body.4: Ozi Weebụsaịtị na Ozi Teknụzụ: Adreesị Internet Protocol (IP); ụdị browser na sistemụ arụmọrụ; ihe njirimara ngwaọrụ na teknụzụ; peeji ndị e letara na oge e ji nọ na weebụsaịtị; weebụsaịtị ma ọ bụ ebe o si bịa; otu e si eji weebụsaịtị na ozi nchọpụta nsogbu; na ihe njirimara cookie na ozi nsochi ndị yiri ya, ebe e mere ka ha rụọ ọrụ.
privacy.sections.1.body.5: Ozi Nkwurịta Okwu na Ajụjụ: Ndekọ ajụjụ na nkwurịta okwu e mere site na weebụsaịtị anyị, email, ekwentị, WhatsApp ma ọ bụ ụzọ nkwurịta okwu ndị ọzọ, gụnyere ozi, arịrịọ maka oge ọhụhụ, ihe ị chọrọ gbasara ọrụ na akwụkwọ ozi ndị metụtara ya. Enwere ike idekọ oku maka nlekọta ịdị mma, ọzụzụ, nchekwa ma ọ bụ ndekọ, ebe o kwesịrị, na ọkwa ma ọ bụ nkwenye kwesịrị ekwesị.
privacy.sections.1.body.6: Ozi Gbasara Ndị Na-elekọta Gị ma ọ bụ Ndị Nnọchiteanya: Ebe onye ọrịa nyere nkọwa onye na-elekọta ya, onye ezinụlọ ma ọ bụ onye nnọchiteanya nwere ikike, anyị nwere ike iji ozi nkwurịta okwu onye ahụ hazie oge ọhụhụ, njem ma ọ bụ ọrụ ndị ọzọ a rịọrọ. Onye na-enye ozi dị otu a kwesịrị inwe ikike kwesịrị ekwesị ịkọrọ ya.
privacy.sections.2.heading: 3. Otu Anyị Si Anakọta Ozi
privacy.sections.2.body.0: Anyị nwere ike ịnakọta ozi ozugbo n'aka gị site na fọm weebụsaịtị, fọm ndebanye aha, oku ekwentị, email ma ọ bụ ngwa ozi.
privacy.sections.2.body.1: Anyị nwere ike ịnakọta ozi mgbe i ji afọ ofufo kọrọ anyị ndekọ ahụike ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ njem, site n'aka onye nnọchiteanya gị nwere ikike ma ọ bụ onye na-elekọta gị, ma ọ bụ site n'aka ụlọ ọgwụ, ndị dọkịta ma ọ bụ ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ so n'ịhazi ọrụ ị rịọrọ, ebe iwu kwere.
privacy.sections.2.body.2: Anyị nwekwara ike ịnakọta ozi n'onwe ya site na cookie, ngwa nyocha ojiji na teknụzụ weebụsaịtị, ma ọ bụ site n'ebe ndị ọzọ iwu kwere ebe ọ dị mkpa iji nye ọrụ a rịọrọ ma ọ bụ mezuo ọrụ iwu.
privacy.sections.2.body.3: Ebe a chọrọ nkwenye, anyị ga-arịọ ya n'ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị tupu anyị ejiri ozi ahụ.
privacy.sections.3.heading: 4. Ihe Anyị Ji Ozi Gị Eme
privacy.sections.3.body.0: Iji zaa ajụjụ ma ghọta ihe ị chọrọ gbasara ahụike.
privacy.sections.3.body.1: Iji hazie ọhụhụ dọkịta, ntụle ọgwụgwọ, oge ọhụhụ na ọrụ ndị metụtara ya.
privacy.sections.3.body.2: Iji kọrọ ụlọ ọgwụ, ndị dọkịta, ebe nyocha na ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ ahụike a họọrọ maka nhazi ọgwụgwọ gị ozi ahụike metụtara ya.
privacy.sections.3.body.3: Iji hazie njem, ebe obibi, ụgbọ na-ebu gị n'ọdụ ụgbọelu na ihe gbasara ndị na-elekọta gị, ebe a rịọrọ ya.
privacy.sections.3.body.4: Iji zisa nkwado oge ọhụhụ, ozi ọhụrụ gbasara ọgwụgwọ, ozi gbasara ọrụ na nhazi njem.
privacy.sections.3.body.5: Iji nye enyemaka ndị ahịa ma zaa mkpesa ma ọ bụ arịrịọ.
privacy.sections.3.body.6: Iji debe ndekọ nke anyị, mee ka ọrụ anyị ka mma ma lekọta weebụsaịtị anyị.
privacy.sections.3.body.7: Iji gbochie aghụghọ, chebe nchekwa ma nyochaa iji ọrụ anyị eme ihe ọjọọ.
privacy.sections.3.body.8: Iji mezuo ihe iwu, ndị na-achịkwa, akaụntụ ma ọ bụ akụkọ chọrọ.
privacy.sections.3.body.9: Iji zisa ozi mgbasa ozi, akwụkwọ ozi ma ọ bụ ihe ọmụmụ ebe e nwetara nkwenye a chọrọ.
privacy.sections.3.body.10: Iji mee nyocha n'ozuzu ma ọ bụ nke na-adịghị egosi onye ọ bụ iji ghọta otu e si eji ọrụ anyị ma mee ka ọrụ anyị ka mma.
privacy.sections.3.body.11: Anyị agaghị eji ozi ahụike gị mee mgbasa ozi na-emetụtaghị ya na-enweghị ihe kpatara ya n'iwu na nkwenye kwesịrị ekwesị, ebe a chọrọ ya.
privacy.sections.4.heading: 5. Nkwenye na Iji Ozi n'Ụzọ Iwu Kwere
privacy.sections.4.body.0: Anyị na-eji ozi onwe n'ihe ndabere iwu kwere, nke nwere ike ịgụnye nkwenye gị, ebe iwu chọrọ ya; iji ya dị mkpa iji nye ọrụ ị rịọrọ ma ọ bụ kwenyere ịnata, ebe iwu kwere; imezu ọrụ iwu metụtara ya; na ihe ndabere ndị ọzọ iwu kwere n'okpuru iwu metụtara ya.
privacy.sections.4.body.1: Ebe anyị dabere na nkwenye, ị nwere ike iwepụ ya dịka iwu siri kwuo. Iwepụ nkwenye agaghị emetụta ma iji ozi e mere tupu iwepụ ya ọ̀ dabara n'iwu.
privacy.sections.4.body.2: Ọ bụrụ na i kpebie ịghara inye ozi dị mkpa maka ọrụ a rịọrọ, anyị nwere ike ọ gaghị ekwe anyị ịhazi ụfọdụ ọhụhụ dọkịta, ntụle ọgwụgwọ ma ọ bụ nhazi njem.
privacy.sections.5.heading: 6. Ịkọrọ na Ikpughe Ozi
privacy.sections.5.body.0: Anyị anaghị ere ozi onwe gị ma ọ bụ ozi ahụike gị.
privacy.sections.5.body.1: Ụlọ ọgwụ, ndị dọkịta na-agwọ gị, ndị ọkachamara, ụlọ nyocha na ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ ahụike so n'ịtụle ma ọ bụ ịhazi ọgwụgwọ ị rịọrọ.
privacy.sections.5.body.2: Ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọelu, ụlọ ọrụ njem, ndị na-enye enyemaka visa, họtel, ndị na-ebu njem na ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ metụtara ya, ebe a chọrọ ya iji hazie njem ma ọ bụ ebe obibi.
privacy.sections.5.body.3: Ndị na-ebuli weebụsaịtị, ndị na-ere ngwa teknụzụ ozi, ngwa CRM, ndị na-enye nchekwa cloud, ọrụ nkwurịta okwu na ndị ọzọ na-akwado ọrụ anyị.
privacy.sections.5.body.4: Ndị ọchịchị, ụlọikpe, ndị na-achịkwa ma ọ bụ ndị uwe ojii ebe iwu chọrọ ma ọ bụ kwere ikpughe ya.
privacy.sections.5.body.5: Onye na-elekọta gị nwere ikike, onye ezinụlọ, onye nnọchiteanya ma ọ bụ onye ọzọ ebe i nyere ikike ikpughe ya ma ọ bụ ebe ikpughe ya dabara n'iwu n'ụzọ ọzọ.
privacy.sections.5.body.6: Anyị na-agbalị ịkọrọ naanị ozi dị mkpa n'ezie maka ebumnuche ahụ. Ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ nwere ike iji ozi ahụ dịka iwu nzuzo nke ha na nkwekọrịta ha siri dị, ebe o kwesịrị.
privacy.sections.6.heading: 7. Iziga Ozi Ná Mba Ọzọ
privacy.sections.6.body.0: Medsafar India nwere ike ịhazi ọgwụgwọ maka ndị ọrịa bi n'India ma ọ bụ ná mba ndị ọzọ. N'ihi ya, ọ nwere ike ịdị mkpa ịkọrọ ndị na-enye ọrụ ahụike ma ọ bụ ndị mmekọ ọrụ nọ n'India ma ọ bụ ná mba ọzọ ozi onwe ma ọ bụ ozi ahụike metụtara ya.
privacy.sections.6.body.1: Iziga ma ọ bụ iji ozi onwe gafere oke mba ọ bụla ga-adabere n'iwu India metụtara ya, gụnyere mmachi ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ ọ bụla ndị ọchịchị metụtara ya tinyere, na ihe ndị ọzọ iwu chọrọ.
privacy.sections.6.body.2: Anyị na-eme ihe kwesịrị ekwesị iji hụ na a na-akọrọ ozi naanị ndị kwesịrị ịnata ya maka ebumnuche ọrụ ziri ezi.
privacy.sections.7.heading: 8. Cookie na Teknụzụ Ndị Yiri Ya
privacy.sections.7.body.0: Weebụsaịtị anyị nwere ike iji cookie na teknụzụ ndị yiri ya iji hụ na weebụsaịtị na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma; cheta ihe ị họọrọ ma mee ka ojiji ya ka mma; ghọta ndị na-abịa na weebụsaịtị na otu e si eji ya; chọpụta nsogbu teknụzụ ma mee ka ọ na-arụ ọrụ ka mma; ma kwado nyocha ojiji na, ebe o kwesịrị, mgbasa ozi dabere na nkwenye.
privacy.sections.7.body.1: Ị nwere ike ịchịkwa ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ cookie site na ntọala browser gị. Ụfọdụ akụkụ weebụsaịtị nwere ike ọ gaghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma ma ọ bụrụ na agbanyụọ ụfọdụ cookie.
privacy.sections.7.body.2: Ebe a chọrọ ya, anyị ga-enweta nkwenye tupu anyị ejiri cookie ndị na-adịghị mkpa ma ọ bụ teknụzụ ndị yiri ha.
privacy.sections.8.heading: 9. Nchekwa Ozi
privacy.sections.8.body.0: Anyị na-eji nchekwa teknụzụ, nhazi na nlekọta kwesịrị ekwesị echebe ozi onwe pụọ n'aka ndị na-enweghị ikike inweta ya, ikpughe ya, ịgbanwe ya, ịtụfu ya ma ọ bụ iji ya eme ihe ọjọọ.
privacy.sections.8.body.1: Dabere n'ụdị ozi ahụ na sistemụ e ji eme ya, nchekwa nwere ike ịgụnye mmachi nnweta na ikike dabere n'ọrụ onye ọ bụla; iziga ozi n'ụzọ echekwara na izobe ozi (encryption) ebe o kwesịrị; nchekwa paswọọdụ na njikwa nchekwa akaụntụ; ihe nzuzo a chọrọ n'aka ndị ọrụ na ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ metụtara ya; nlekọta nchekwa, ndabere ozi (backup) na usoro nzaghachi ihe mberede; na ntụle oge ụfọdụ nke otu e si elekọta ozi.
privacy.sections.8.body.2: Otú ọ dị, ọ dịghị weebụsaịtị, iziga ozi n'ịntanetị ma ọ bụ sistemụ nchekwa a pụrụ ikwe nkwa na ọ dị nchebe kpam kpam. Anyị enweghị ike ikwe nkwa nchekwa zuru oke, mana anyị ga-eme ihe kwesịrị ekwesị iji dozie ihe mberede nchekwa dịka iwu metụtara ya siri kwuo.
privacy.sections.9.heading: 10. Idebe na Ihichapụ Ozi
privacy.sections.9.body.0: Anyị na-edebe ozi onwe naanị ruo oge ọ dị mkpa n'ezie iji mezuo ebumnuche a kọwara n'Iwu a, nye ọrụ a rịọrọ, debe ndekọ a chọrọ, dozie esemokwu, chebe ọdịmma ziri ezi ma ọ bụ mezuo ọrụ iwu metụtara ya.
privacy.sections.9.body.1: Oge e ji edebe ozi nwere ike ịdị iche dabere n'ụdị ozi ahụ na ụdị ọrụ e nyere.
privacy.sections.9.body.2: Mgbe a naghịzi achọ ozi, anyị ga-eme ihe kwesịrị ekwesị iji hichapụ ya ma ọ bụ mee ka ọ ghara igosi onye ọ bụ, dabere n'ihe iwu chọrọ na mkpa ọ bụla ziri ezi idebe ya.
privacy.sections.9.body.3: Ị nwere ike ịrịọ ka e hichapụ ozi onwe gị, dabere n'iwu metụtara ya. Ọ nwere ike ịdị mkpa idebe ụfọdụ ozi ebe iwu chọrọ ya ma ọ bụ maka iwepụta, iji ma ọ bụ ịgbachitere onwe anyị n'ikpe.
privacy.sections.10.heading: 11. Ikike Nzuzo Gị
privacy.sections.10.body.0: Dabere n'iwu metụtara ya, ị nwere ike inwe ikike ịrịọ ozi gbasara ozi onwe anyị na-eji gbasara gị; ịrịọ ka e mezie ma ọ bụ melite ozi na-ezighị ezi ma ọ bụ nke na-ezughị ezu; ịrịọ ka e hichapụ ozi onwe ebe iwu kwere; iwepụ nkwenye maka iji ozi ebe iji ya dabere na nkwenye; itinye mkpesa gbasara otu e si eji ozi onwe gị; ịhọpụta onye ọzọ ga-eji ikike ndị a ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwụọ ma ọ bụ na ị nweghị ike, ebe iwu nyere ya; na iji ikike ndị ọzọ dị n'okpuru iwu nchekwa ozi metụtara ya.
privacy.sections.10.body.1: Iji ikike gị, biko kpọtụrụ anyị site na nkọwa e nyere na ngalaba Kpọtụrụ Anyị dị n'okpuru. Anyị nwere ike ịchọ ịkwado onye ị bụ tupu anyị emee ihe gbasara arịrịọ gị.
privacy.sections.11.heading: 12. Ozi Mgbasa Ozi
privacy.sections.11.body.0: Anyị nwere ike iziga ozi gbasara ọrụ anyị, mmemme ahụike, ọrụ enyemaka ndị ọrịa, mmemme ma ọ bụ ihe ọmụmụ ebe iwu metụtara ya kwere ma ebe e nwetara nkwenye dị mkpa.
privacy.sections.11.body.1: Ị nwere ike ịkwụsị ịnata ozi mgbasa ozi n'oge ọ bụla site n'iso ntuziaka ịkwụsị ịnata ozi dị n'ime ozi ahụ ma ọ bụ site n'ịkpọtụrụ anyị ozugbo.
privacy.sections.11.body.2: Ọbụlagodi na ị kwụsịrị ịnata mgbasa ozi, anyị nwere ike ịga n'ihu iziga ozi dị mkpa gbasara ọrụ, dịka ozi gbasara oge ọhụhụ ma ọ bụ ozi ọhụrụ gbasara arịrịọ i mere.
privacy.sections.12.heading: 13. Weebụsaịtị na Ọrụ nke Ndị Ọzọ
privacy.sections.12.body: Weebụsaịtị anyị nwere ike inwe njikọ na weebụsaịtị ndị ọzọ, weebụsaịtị ụlọ ọgwụ, ngwa ndebe oge ma ọ bụ ọrụ ndị ọzọ. Weebụsaịtị na ọrụ ndị a nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ n'okpuru iwu nzuzo na usoro nke ha. Medsafar India anaghị achịkwa otu ndị ọzọ nọọrọ onwe ha si elekọta nzuzo, ọ na-agbakwa gị ume ka ị gụọ iwu ha tupu ị kọrọ ha ozi onwe.
privacy.sections.13.heading: 14. Ọkwa Gbasara Ahụike na Ọrụ Medsafar India
privacy.sections.13.body.0: Medsafar India na-arụ ọrụ dịka onye na-ahazi njem maka ọgwụgwọ na ọrụ nhazi ndị ọrịa. Ọ gwụla ma e kwuru ya n'ụzọ doro anya n'akwụkwọ nkwekọrịta ọzọ e dere ede, anyị anaghị achọpụta ọrịa n'onwe anyị, anaghị ede ọgwụ, anaghịkwa enye ọgwụgwọ.
privacy.sections.13.body.1: Ntụle ahụike, nchọpụta ọrịa, ndụmọdụ ọgwụgwọ na mkpebi gbasara ọgwụgwọ bụ ọrụ ndị ọkachamara ahụike tozuru etozu na ụlọ ọrụ ahụike metụtara ya.
privacy.sections.13.body.2: Ịkọrọ anyị ozi ahụike n'onwe ya anaghị eme ka e nwee mmekọrịta dọkịta na onye ọrịa n'etiti gị na Medsafar India.
privacy.sections.14.heading: 15. Nzuzo Ụmụaka
privacy.sections.14.body.0: Ọrụ anyị nwere ike mgbe ụfọdụ ịgụnye nhazi ọgwụgwọ ma ọ bụ njem maka ndị na-erubeghị afọ 18.
privacy.sections.14.body.1: Ebe ozi onwe metụtara nwata, anyị ga-eji ya dịka iwu metụtara ya siri kwuo ma nweta nkwenye a pụrụ ịkwado n'aka nne ma ọ bụ nna ya ma ọ bụ onye nlekọta ya n'iwu ebe a chọrọ ya.
privacy.sections.14.body.2: Anyị anaghị ama ụma anakọta ozi onwe ụmụaka maka ebumnuche na-emetụtaghị ya ma ọ bụ jiri ya mee mgbasa ozi lekwasịrị anya ebe iwu machibidoro ya.
privacy.sections.15.heading: 16. Mgbanwe n'Iwu Nzuzo A
privacy.sections.15.body.0: Anyị nwere ike imelite Iwu Nzuzo a site n'oge ruo n'oge iji gosi mgbanwe n'ọrụ anyị, teknụzụ, otu anyị si azụ ahịa ma ọ bụ ihe iwu metụtara ya chọrọ.
privacy.sections.15.body.1: A ga-ebipụta ụdị e degharịrị na weebụsaịtị anyị ya na ụbọchị “Mmelite Ikpeazụ” ọhụrụ. Ebe iwu chọrọ ya, anyị ga-enye ọkwa ọzọ ma ọ bụ nweta nkwenye maka mgbanwe dị mkpa.
privacy.sections.15.body.2: Anyị na-agba gị ume ka ị na-agụ peeji a site n'oge ruo n'oge.
privacy.sections.16.heading: 17. Kpọtụrụ Anyị na Ndozi Mkpesa
privacy.sections.16.body.0: Ọ bụrụ na i nwere ajụjụ, nchegbu ma ọ bụ arịrịọ ọ bụla gbasara Iwu Nzuzo a ma ọ bụ otu e si eji ozi onwe gị, biko kpọtụrụ anyị:
privacy.sections.16.body.4: Ọfịs E Debanyere Aha: Office No. 222, 2nd Floor, NEO Corporate Plaza, Ramchandra Lane, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400064, India
privacy.sections.16.body.5: Onye A Ga-akpọtụrụ Maka Nzuzo na Mkpesa: Medsafar India Privacy Team
privacy.sections.16.body.6: Anyị ga-enyocha ma zaa arịrịọ ma ọ bụ mkpesa gbasara nzuzo n'ime oge iwu metụtara ya kwuru.
privacy.sections.17.heading: Nkwa Anyị Nye Ndị Ọrịa
privacy.sections.17.body: Na Medsafar India, anyị ghọtara na ozi ahụike bụ ihe dị nnọọ n'onwe mmadụ. Anyị kwere nkwa iji nlekọta, nzuzo na nsọpụrụ were ozi ndị ọrịa, ma jiri ya n'ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị maka nhazi ọgwụgwọ na ọrụ ndị metụtara ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body: Ihe ọ bụla gbasara ahụike, dịka ihe ọgwụgwọ bụ, onye chọrọ ya na ogologo oge mgbake na-ewe, dọkịta na-elele ya tupu e bipụta ya. Ruo mgbe ahụ, a na-aka ya akara "Na-eche nlele dọkịta" na peeji ahụ.
specialities.general-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ izugbe na nke obere oghere
specialities.general-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ a na-emekarị dịka iwepụ akpa nkụ (gallbladder), ịrụzi hernia na iwepụ appendix, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot ka mgbake dị ngwa.
specialities.gastroenterology.name: Ọgwụgwọ afọ na imeju (gastroenterology)
specialities.gastroenterology.summary: Nyocha na ọgwụgwọ maka afọ, eriri afọ, imeju na pancreas, gụnyere endoscopy, ERCP na nlekọta maka abụba imeju na cirrhosis.
specialities.urology.name: Urology
specialities.urology.summary: Nlekọta maka akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị na prostate, na akụkụ ahụ ọmụmụ nwoke, site na nkume akụrụ ruo n'ịwa ahụ akụrụ na prostate site na robot.
specialities.gynaecology.name: Ọgwụgwọ ụmụ nwanyị (gynaecology)
specialities.gynaecology.summary: Nlekọta na ịwa ahụ maka akpanwa, akpa nwa (ovaries) na eriri akpanwa (fallopian tubes), nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
specialities.ent.name: Ntị, imi na akpịrị (ENT)
specialities.ent.summary: Ọgwụgwọ maka ntị, imi, sinus, akpịrị na igbe olu, gụnyere ịwa ahụ sinus.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.name: Ọgwụgwọ CAR-T cell (adoptive cell therapy)
treatments.radiation-therapy.name: Ọgwụgwọ radieshọn (external beam, EBRT)
treatments.thyroid-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ thyroid na parathyroid (thyroidectomy)
treatments.endoscopic-spine-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ ọkpụkpụ azụ site na endoscope na obere oghere
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ bypass obi (CABG, ịwa ahụ obi meghere emeghe)
treatments.minimally-invasive-heart-surg: Ịwa ahụ obi site n'obere oghere na site na robot
treatments.varicose-veins.name: Ọgwụgwọ varicose veins (laser na sclerotherapy)
treatments.varicose-veins.what: N'ịdabere na ultrasound, a na-etinye obere tube n'ime akwara ọbara (vein) na-adịghị mma, ma were okpomọkụ (laser ma ọ bụ radiofrequency) ma ọ bụ gluu ahụike mechie ya. Ọbara na-esizi n'akwara ndị dị mma agafe. Enwere ike iji ịgba ọgwụ (sclerotherapy) gwọọ akwara ndị pere mpe. Enwekwara ike iji catheter gwọọ ọbara kpụkọrọ akpụkọ n'akwara dị n'ime (DVT).
treatments.hair-transplant.name: Ntụgharị ntutu (FUE na FUT)
treatments.heart-transplant.name: Ntụgharị obi
treatments.heart-transplant.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-eji obi dị mma sitere n'aka onye nwụrụ anwụ nyere ya dochie obi na-ada ada.
treatments.heart-transplant.what: A na-ewepụ obi rịara ọrịa ma jikọọ obi onye nyere ya na akwara ọbara ndị bụ isi. Mgbe a na-eche onye ga-enye obi, a na-eji igwe na-agba ọbara (ventricular assist device, VAD) akwado ụfọdụ ndị ọrịa. Mgbe ntụgharị ahụ gasịrị, a na-aṅụ ọgwụ kwa ụbọchị ka ahụ ghara ịjụ obi ọhụrụ ahụ.
treatments.heart-transplant.who: Ndị nwere obi na-ada ada nke ọkwa ikpeazụ nke ọgwụ, ngwaọrụ na ịwa ahụ ndị ọzọ na-enweghịzi ike inyere aka.
treatments.heart-transplant.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ihe dị ka izu 3 ruo 4 n'ụlọ ọgwụ, gụnyere oge n'ICU. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.heart-transplant.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka ọnwa 3 maka nlele siri ike. A na-aṅụ ọgwụ mgbochi ịjụ akụkụ ahụ ndụ niile.
treatments.heart-transplant.faq.0.answer: Ee. Obi na-esi n'aka ndị nwụrụ anwụ, ya mere ndị ọrịa na-abanye n'ndepụta ndị na-eche. Ndị otu ntụgharị ga-akọwa otu o si arụ ọrụ maka ndị ọrịa si ná mba ọzọ.
treatments.robotic-cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa site na robot
treatments.robotic-cancer-surgery.summar: Ịwa ahụ kansa a na-eme site n'obere ọnya site na robot ịwa ahụ, iji wepụ ya nke ọma karịa ma gbakee ngwa ngwa.
treatments.robotic-cancer-surgery.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-achịkwa aka robot site na kọnsolụ, na-ahụ ihe n'ụdị 3D e mere ka ọ buo ibu. A na-eji ya maka kansa prostate, akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị, akpanwa, eriri afọ, ọkpọ nri, ngụgụ, thyroid na ndị ọzọ.
treatments.robotic-cancer-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa a pụrụ iwepụ site n'ịwa ahụ, ebe ndị otu dọkịta kpebiri na ịwa ahụ site na robot dabara n'okwu ahụ.
treatments.robotic-cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 5, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.robotic-cancer-surgery.recove: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'obere ọrụ n'ime izu 2 ruo 3, ngwa ngwa karịa mgbe ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe gasịrị.
treatments.robotic-prostatectomy.name: Robotic prostatectomy (ịwa ahụ kansa prostate)
treatments.robotic-prostatectomy.summary: Iwepụ prostate site na robot ịwa ahụ, iji gwọọ kansa prostate na-agbasabeghị.
treatments.robotic-prostatectomy.what: A na-ewepụ prostate dum na gland ndị dị nso site n'obere ọnya. Izi ezi nke robot ahụ na-enyere dọkịta na-awa ahụ aka ichebe akwara na-achịkwa mamịrị na ike nwoke (erection).
treatments.robotic-prostatectomy.who: Ụmụ nwoke nwere kansa prostate nọ naanị n'ime prostate, ndị ahụ ha siri ike maka ịwa ahụ.
treatments.robotic-prostatectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.robotic-prostatectomy.recover: Catheter mamịrị na-anọ ihe dị ka izu 1 ruo 2. Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwoke na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6; njikwa mamịrị na-akakarị mma n'ime izu ruo ọnwa.
treatments.radical-nephrectomy.name: Radical nephrectomy (iwepụ akụrụ)
treatments.radical-nephrectomy.summary: Iwepụ akụrụ dum, nke a na-emekarị iji gwọọ kansa akụrụ buru ibu.
treatments.radical-nephrectomy.what: A na-ewepụ akụrụ ahụ, abụba gbara ya gburugburu na mgbe ụfọdụ adrenal gland, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot. Akụrụ nke ọzọ na-arụzi ọrụ ya.
treatments.radical-nephrectomy.who: Ndị nwere etuto akụrụ buru oke ibu ma ọ bụ nọ n'etiti nke na a pụghị iwepụ naanị ya.
treatments.radical-nephrectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.radical-nephrectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.name: Robotic partial nephrectomy
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.summary: Iwepụ naanị etuto ahụ na obere akụkụ akụrụ dị mma gbara ya gburugburu, ka akụrụ fọdụrụ nọgide na-arụ ọrụ.
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.what: Site na robot ịwa ahụ, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ebepụ etuto ahụ ma kwachie akụrụ ahụ, ka a zọpụta ọtụtụ akụkụ akụrụ ahụ.
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.who: Ndị nwere obere etuto akụrụ, ọkachasị ndị nwere naanị otu akụrụ ma ọ bụ ndị akụrụ ha anaghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma.
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 4. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 3 ruo 4.
treatments.cystectomy.name: Cystectomy (iwepụ eriri afọ mamịrị)
treatments.cystectomy.summary: Iwepụ akụkụ ma ọ bụ eriri afọ mamịrị dum, ọkachasị iji gwọọ kansa eriri afọ mamịrị.
treatments.cystectomy.what: A na-ewepụ eriri afọ mamịrị, nke a na-emekarị site na robot. Mgbe e wepụrụ ya dum, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-emepụta ụzọ ọhụrụ mamịrị ga-esi apụ n'ahụ, ma ọ bụ obere akpa n'afọ ma ọ bụ eriri afọ mamịrị ọhụrụ e ji eriri afọ mee.
treatments.cystectomy.who: Ndị nwere kansa eriri afọ mamịrị tobanyere n'akwara eriri afọ mamịrị, ma ọ bụ nke na-alọghachi ugboro ugboro.
treatments.cystectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 7 ruo 10. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.cystectomy.recovery: Mee atụmatụ izu 6 ruo 8 tupu ọrụ nkịtị, ya na enyemaka nọọsụ iji mụta otu e si elekọta ụzọ mamịrị ọhụrụ ahụ.
treatments.orchiectomy.name: Orchiectomy (iwepụ mkpụrụ amụ)
treatments.orchiectomy.summary: Iwepụ otu ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ amụ abụọ, iji gwọọ kansa mkpụrụ amụ ma ọ bụ iji belata homonụ na kansa prostate.
treatments.orchiectomy.what: Site n'obere ọnya n'ebe ukwu na apata ụkwụ zutere (groin) ma ọ bụ n'akpa amụ, a na-ewepụ mkpụrụ amụ ahụ. Enwere ike itinye ihe e mepụtara n'ọnọdụ ya maka ọdịdị ma ọ bụrụ na a chọrọ ya.
treatments.orchiectomy.who: Ụmụ nwoke nwere kansa mkpụrụ amụ, na ụfọdụ ụmụ nwoke nwere kansa prostate gbasara agbasa.
treatments.orchiectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.orchiectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwoke na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.lumpectomy.name: Lumpectomy (ịwa ahụ na-echekwa ara)
treatments.lumpectomy.summary: Iwepụ kansa ara ya na oke anụ ahụ dị mma, ka a hapụ ara fọdụrụ.
treatments.lumpectomy.what: A na-ewepụ etuto ahụ na obere akụkụ gbara ya gburugburu, nke a na-emekarị ya na ụfọdụ lymph node site n'okpuru ogwe aka. A na-esokarị ya ọgwụgwọ radieshọn iji belata ohere kansa ahụ ga-alọghachi.
treatments.lumpectomy.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere kansa ara nke mmalite pere mpe ma e jiri ya tụnyere nha ara ahụ.
treatments.lumpectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.lumpectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2, tupu ọgwụgwọ radieshọn amalite.
treatments.mastectomy.name: Mastectomy (iwepụ ara)
treatments.mastectomy.summary: Iwepụ ara dum iji gwọọ ma ọ bụ gbochie kansa ara, ya na nhọrọ iwughachi ya.
treatments.mastectomy.what: A na-ewepụ anụ ara, mgbe ụfọdụ a na-ahapụ akpụkpọ ahụ ma ọ bụ isi ara. Enwekwara ike iwepụ lymph node site n'okpuru ogwe aka. Enwere ike iwughachi ara n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ ma ọ bụ ma emechaa.
treatments.mastectomy.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere kansa ara buru ibu ma ọ bụ gbasara agbasa, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere nnukwu ihe ize ndụ kansa ara e ketara eketa.
treatments.mastectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 4, karịa ya ma e wughachiri ara. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.mastectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 3 ruo 6.
treatments.hemicolectomy.name: Hemicolectomy (ịwa ahụ kansa eriri afọ)
treatments.hemicolectomy.summary: Iwepụ ọkara aka nri ma ọ bụ aka ekpe nke eriri afọ ukwu, nke a na-emekarị maka kansa eriri afọ.
treatments.hemicolectomy.what: A na-ewepụ akụkụ colon metụtara ya na lymph node ya, ma jikọọ nsọtụ abụọ dị mma. A na-emekarị ya site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
treatments.hemicolectomy.who: Ndị nwere kansa eriri afọ, na ụfọdụ ndị nwere ọrịa eriri afọ siri ike dịka ọrịa Crohn.
treatments.hemicolectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 7. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hemicolectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.hepatectomy.name: Hepatectomy (iwepụ akụkụ imeju)
treatments.hepatectomy.summary: Iwepụ akụkụ imeju iji wepụ etuto. Imeju fọdụrụ na-etolite ọzọ.
treatments.hepatectomy.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ akụkụ imeju nwere etuto ahụ. Imeju fọdụrụ na-etolite ọzọ n'ime izu ole na ole. Enwere ike ime ya site n'ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe, site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
treatments.hepatectomy.who: Ndị nwere kansa imeju, ma ọ bụ kansa si n'eriri afọ gbasaa ruo n'imeju, mgbe imeju dị mma zuru ezu ga-afọdụ.
treatments.hepatectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 10. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hepatectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 6 ruo 8.
treatments.whipple-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ Whipple (pancreaticoduodenectomy)
treatments.whipple-surgery.summary: Nnukwu ịwa ahụ na-ewepụ isi pancreas na akụkụ ahụ ndị dị nso, iji gwọọ kansa dị n'akụkụ ahụ.
treatments.whipple-surgery.what: A na-ewepụ isi pancreas, akụkụ mbụ nke obere eriri afọ, akpa nkụ (gallbladder) na akụkụ nke ọwa nkụ (bile duct). A na-ejikọghachi pancreas, ọwa nkụ na afọ n'eriri afọ.
treatments.whipple-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa n'isi pancreas, ọwa nkụ ma ọ bụ ampulla, na ụfọdụ ndị nwere etuto na-abụghị kansa n'ebe ahụ.
treatments.whipple-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 10 ruo 14. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.whipple-surgery.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka izu 3 ruo 4. Mgbake zuru ezu na-ewe ọnwa 2 ruo 3.
treatments.pancreatectomy.name: Pancreatectomy (ịwa ahụ pancreas)
treatments.pancreatectomy.summary: Iwepụ akụkụ ma ọ bụ pancreas dum, maka etuto, cyst ma ọ bụ ọzịza ogologo oge.
treatments.pancreatectomy.what: Dabere n'ebe nsogbu ahụ dị, a na-ewepụ ọdụ, ahụ ma ọ bụ pancreas dum. Ụfọdụ ịwa ahụ na-ewepụkwa spleen. Ọ bụrụ na e wepụrụ pancreas dum, a ga-achọ insulin na enzyme mgbari nri ma emechaa.
treatments.pancreatectomy.who: Ndị nwere etuto ma ọ bụ cyst pancreas, na ụfọdụ ndị nwere chronic pancreatitis siri ike.
treatments.pancreatectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 7 ruo 12. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.pancreatectomy.recovery: Mgbake zuru ezu na-ewekarị izu 6 ruo 8.
treatments.laryngectomy.name: Laryngectomy (iwepụ igbe olu)
treatments.laryngectomy.summary: Iwepụ akụkụ ma ọ bụ igbe olu (larynx) dum, iji gwọọ kansa akpịrị.
treatments.laryngectomy.what: Na partial laryngectomy, a na-ewepụ naanị akụkụ metụtara ya, a na-echekwakarị olu. Na total laryngectomy, a na-ewepụ igbe olu dum, onye ahụ na-esi n'oghere dị n'olu eku ume. Enwere ike iji valvụ olu ma ọ bụ ụzọ ndị ọzọ weghachi ikwu okwu.
treatments.laryngectomy.who: Ndị nwere kansa igbe olu, ma ọ bụ kansa lọghachiri mgbe ọgwụgwọ radieshọn gasịrị.
treatments.laryngectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 10 ruo 14. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.laryngectomy.recovery: Ọgwụgwọ ikwu okwu na ilo nri na-amalite n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Mee atụmatụ ihe dị ka izu 4 ruo 6 n'India.
treatments.neck-dissection.name: Neck dissection (iwepụ lymph node olu)
treatments.neck-dissection.summary: Iwepụ lymph node dị n'olu, iji gwọọ ma ọ bụ lelee ma kansa isi na olu ọ̀ gbasaala.
treatments.neck-dissection.what: A na-ewepụ lymph node dị n'otu akụkụ ma ọ bụ akụkụ abụọ nke olu, mgbe ụfọdụ ya na akwara anụ ahụ ma ọ bụ vein dị nso. A na-emekarị ya n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ e ji ewepụ etuto bụ isi.
treatments.neck-dissection.who: Ndị nwere kansa ọnụ, akpịrị, igbe olu, thyroid ma ọ bụ akpụkpọ ahụ gbasaala, ma ọ bụ nwere ike ịgbasa, ruo n'olu.
treatments.neck-dissection.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.neck-dissection.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 3 ruo 4. Mmega ahụ olu na ubu na-enyere aka.
treatments.glossectomy.name: Glossectomy (ịwa ahụ kansa ire)
treatments.glossectomy.summary: Iwepụ akụkụ ma ọ bụ ire dum iji gwọọ kansa ire, nke a na-esokarị iwughachi ire ahụ.
treatments.glossectomy.what: A na-ewepụ akụkụ ire nwere kansa ahụ. Mgbe e wepụrụ nnukwu akụkụ, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-eji anụ ahụ si n'ogwe aka ma ọ bụ apata ụkwụ wughachi ya, iji nyere aka n'ikwu okwu na ilo nri.
treatments.glossectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 7 ruo 14. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.glossectomy.recovery: Ọgwụgwọ ikwu okwu na ilo nri na-enyere aka. Mee atụmatụ ihe dị ka izu 3 ruo 4 n'India.
treatments.maxillectomy.name: Maxillectomy (ịwa ahụ agba elu)
treatments.maxillectomy.summary: Iwepụ akụkụ agba elu, iji gwọọ kansa sinus, ọnụ elu (palate) ma ọ bụ anụ ezé elu.
treatments.maxillectomy.what: A na-ewepụ ọkpụkpụ agba elu metụtara ya. A na-eji efere ezé (obturator) mejupụta oghere ahụ ma ọ bụ were ọkpụkpụ na anụ ahụ si n'akụkụ ahụ ọzọ wughachi ya.
treatments.maxillectomy.who: Ndị nwere kansa agba elu, ọnụ elu siri ike (hard palate), anụ ezé elu ma ọ bụ maxillary sinus.
treatments.maxillectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 10. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.maxillectomy.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ihe dị ka izu 3 ruo 4 n'India, ya na nsochi maka efere ahụ ma ọ bụ agba e wughachiri.
treatments.mandibulectomy.name: Mandibulectomy (ịwa ahụ agba ala)
treatments.mandibulectomy.summary: Iwepụ akụkụ agba ala, iji gwọọ kansa ọnụ ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ agba, ya na iwughachi agba ahụ.
treatments.mandibulectomy.what: A na-ewepụ akụkụ agba ala metụtara ya. A na-ewughachikarị agba ahụ n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ site n'ọkpụkpụ si n'ụkwụ (fibula), nke e jiri microsurgery jikọọ.
treatments.mandibulectomy.who: Ndị nwere kansa ọnụ ruru ọkpụkpụ agba, na ụfọdụ etuto ọkpụkpụ agba.
treatments.mandibulectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 10 ruo 14. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.mandibulectomy.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ihe dị ka izu 4 n'India. Iri nri na ikwu okwu na-aka mma n'izu ndị na-esote.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.name: Iwepụ lymph node (lymphadenectomy)
treatments.lymph-node-removal.summary: Iwepụ lymph node dị nso na kansa, iji gwọọ ya ma ọ bụ iji hụ ma ọ̀ gbasaala.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ otu lymph node na-adọrọ mmiri si n'ebe kansa ahụ dị, dịka n'okpuru ogwe aka, n'ebe ukwu na apata ụkwụ zutere (groin), n'ukwu ma ọ bụ n'afọ. Dọkịta pathologist na-elezi ha anya maka mkpụrụ ndụ kansa.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.who: Ndị nwere kansa na-agbasa site na lymph node, dịka kansa ara, akpụkpọ ahụ, akpanwa, prostate na eriri afọ.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 4, dabere n'ebe ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 4. Mgbe ụfọdụ, ogwe aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ nwere ike ịza aza mgbe e mechara.
treatments.omentectomy.name: Omentectomy
treatments.omentectomy.summary: Iwepụ omentum, akwa abụba dị n'afọ, nke a na-emekarị dịka akụkụ nke ịwa ahụ kansa akpa nwa (ovary) ma ọ bụ kansa afọ.
treatments.omentectomy.what: A na-ewepụ omentum, nke kwụ n'ihu eriri afọ, n'ihi na kansa nwere ike ịgbasa ruo n'ime ya. A na-emekarị ya ya na ịwa ahụ kansa ọzọ.
treatments.omentectomy.who: Ndị nwere kansa akpa nwa (ovary), akpanwa, afọ ma ọ bụ eriri afọ, ma ọ bụ kansa gbasara n'afọ.
treatments.omentectomy.stay: Ọ na-adịkarị ka nke ịwa ahụ bụ isi, ihe dị ka ụbọchị 5 ruo 7. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.omentectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.name: Radical hysterectomy
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.summary: Iwepụ akpanwa, ọnụ akpanwa (cervix), elu ọtụ na anụ ahụ dị nso, iji gwọọ kansa ọnụ akpanwa ma ọ bụ kansa akpanwa.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.what: A na-ewepụ anụ ahụ karịa n'hysterectomy nkịtị, nke a na-emekarị ya na lymph node dị n'ukwu. A na-emekarị ya site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere kansa ọnụ akpanwa nke mmalite, na ụfọdụ ndị nwere kansa akpanwa.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 6 ruo 8.
treatments.mohs-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ Mohs (kansa akpụkpọ ahụ)
treatments.mohs-surgery.summary: A na-ewepụ kansa akpụkpọ ahụ n'akwa n'akwa, na-elele akwa ọ bụla n'okpuru microscope, ka a ghara ịtụfu akpụkpọ ahụ dị mma karịa ka ọ dị mkpa.
treatments.mohs-surgery.what: N'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu nke ebe ahụ (local anaesthetic), dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ akwa dị gịrịgịrị ma lelee ya ozugbo. A na-emeghachi nke a ruo mgbe kansa ọ bụla na-afọdụghị. A na-emechizi ma ọ bụ rụzie ọnya ahụ.
treatments.mohs-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa akpụkpọ ahụ basal cell ma ọ bụ squamous cell, ọkachasị n'ihu, ntị, aka ma ọ bụ ebe ndị ọzọ ichekwa akpụkpọ ahụ dị mkpa.
treatments.mohs-surgery.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: a na-eme ya n'otu ụbọchị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.mohs-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole. A na-ewepụ eriri a kwara akwa n'ime ihe dị ka otu izu.
treatments.adjuvant-neoadjuvant-chemothe: Chemotherapy a na-enye tupu ịwa ahụ iji mee ka etuto belata (neoadjuvant), ma ọ bụ mgbe ya gasịrị iji belata ohere kansa ahụ ga-alọghachi (adjuvant).

A na-enye ọgwụ kansa n'usoro, nke a na-esikarị na drip, n'ime ọnwa ole na ole. Tupu ịwa ahụ, ha nwere ike ime ka etuto belata ma dị mfe iwepụ. Mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị, ha na-agwọ mkpụrụ ndụ kansa ọ bụla fọdụrụ. Ọgwụgwọ adjuvant nwekwara ike ịpụta radieshọn, ọgwụgwọ homonụ ma ọ bụ ọgwụgwọ lekwasịrị anya (targeted therapy) mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị.
Ndị nwere kansa dịka kansa ara, eriri afọ, afọ, ọkpọ nri, eriri afọ mamịrị na ngụgụ, dịka ndị otu dọkịta kansa dụrụ ọdụ.
A na-enyekarị ya dịka onye ọrịa nke ehihie. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
Ike ọgwụgwụ na mmetụta ndị ọzọ na-ebelatakarị izu ole na ole mgbe usoro ikpeazụ gasịrị.
treatments.hormone-therapy.name: Ọgwụgwọ homonụ maka kansa
treatments.hormone-therapy.summary: Ọgwụ na-egbochi ma ọ bụ na-ebelata homonụ ụfọdụ kansa chọrọ iji too.
treatments.hormone-therapy.what: Mkpụrụ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ ịgba ọgwụ na-akwụsị ahụ ịmepụta homonụ, ma ọ bụ na-akwụsị kansa iji ya. A na-enyekarị ya ruo ọnwa ma ọ bụ afọ, ya na ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ ma ọ bụ mgbe ha gasịrị.
treatments.hormone-therapy.who: Ndị nwere kansa homonụ na-emetụta, ọkachasị kansa ara na prostate, na ụfọdụ kansa akpanwa.
treatments.hormone-therapy.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: mkpụrụ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ ịgba ọgwụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hormone-therapy.recovery: A na-aga n'ihu n'ọgwụgwọ ahụ n'ụlọ, ya na nlele site n'aka dọkịta nke gị.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.name: Photodynamic therapy
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.summary: Ọgwụ ìhè na-emetụta na ìhè pụrụ iche a na-eji ọnụ ebibi mkpụrụ ndụ kansa ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ndụ na-achọ ịghọ kansa.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.what: A na-enye ọgwụ na-agbakọ na mkpụrụ ndụ na-adịghị mma, wee were laser ma ọ bụ oriọna nye ebe ahụ ìhè. Ìhè ahụ na-eme ka ọgwụ ahụ malite ọrụ, ọ na-ebibikwa mkpụrụ ndụ ndị ahụ.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.who: Ndị nwere ụfọdụ kansa akpụkpọ ahụ na ihe na-achọ ịghọ kansa, na ụfọdụ kansa mmalite nke ọkpọ nri ma ọ bụ ngụgụ.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị na ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ, ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.recovery: Akpụkpọ ahụ a gwọrọ na-egbu mgbu ụbọchị ole na ole. Ị ga-ezere ìhè na-enwu gbaa ruo oge ụfọdụ mgbe e mechara.
treatments.brachytherapy.name: Brachytherapy (radieshọn n'ime ahụ)
treatments.brachytherapy.summary: Radieshọn a na-enye site n'ime ahụ, site n'itinye ihe na-enye radieshọn n'ime ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ etuto ahụ.
treatments.brachytherapy.what: Obere tube ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ dị ntakịrị na-ebuga radieshọn ahụ ozugbo na kansa ahụ, ka ọtụtụ radieshọn ruo n'etuto ahụ, obere ihe eruo n'anụ ahụ dị mma. Enwere ike inye ya n'oge mkpụmkpụ ole na ole ma ọ bụ dịka mkpụrụ a hapụrụ n'ebe ahụ.
treatments.brachytherapy.who: Ndị nwere kansa ọnụ akpanwa, akpanwa, prostate, ara, na ụfọdụ kansa isi na olu.
treatments.brachytherapy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ; ụfọdụ ọgwụgwọ chọrọ abalị 1 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.brachytherapy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole.
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.sum: Radieshọn dị ike nke ukwuu, nke ziri ezi nke ukwuu, a na-elekwasị n'obere ebe site n'ọtụtụ akụkụ, n'oge otu ruo ise.
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.wha: A naghị ebe ọnya. Foto nyocha (scan) zuru ezu na-eduzi ọtụtụ ìhè radieshọn dị gịrịgịrị na-ezukọ n'etuto ahụ. A na-eji ya n'ụbụrụ (SRS) na n'ahụ, dịka ngụgụ, imeju na ọkpụkpụ azụ (SBRT).
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.who: Ndị nwere obere etuto ụbụrụ, kansa gbasara ruo n'ụbụrụ ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ azụ, kansa ngụgụ nke mmalite, na ụfọdụ kansa imeju na prostate.
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.sta: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: oge otu ruo ise a na-abịa ma laa. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.rec: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'otu ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ n'echi ya.
treatments.tomotherapy.name: Tomotherapy
treatments.tomotherapy.summary: Ọgwụgwọ radieshọn a na-enye n'ụzọ gburugburu, ya na foto nyocha (scan) tupu oge ọ bụla, iji kpụọ radieshọn ahụ ka o dabara etuto ahụ nke ọma.
